method: scripts/llm/generate-examples.ts：每字 2 句，依 ECDICT 中文釋義與 OEWN 英英釋義選常見詞義，中文為台灣用語意譯

examples.en: The screw is only five mm long, so handle it carefully.
examples.zh: 這根螺絲只有五毫米長，所以要小心拿。

examples.en: Please cut the wire about ten mm shorter than the old one.
examples.zh: 請把這條線剪得比舊的短約十毫米。

examples.en: Her uncle has been a loyal republican for over thirty years.
examples.zh: 她的叔叔三十多年來一直是忠誠的共和黨員。

examples.en: Many republican voters supported the new tax plan.
examples.zh: 許多共和黨選民支持這項新的稅務方案。

examples.en: Congress will vote on the bill next week.
examples.zh: 國會將於下週對這項法案進行表決。

examples.en: Scientists from around the world attended the medical congress in Taipei.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的科學家參加了在台北舉行的醫學會議。

examples.en: Tourism is the fastest-growing sector of the local economy.
examples.zh: 觀光業是當地經濟中成長最快速的部門。

examples.en: The technology sector added thousands of jobs last year.
examples.zh: 科技產業去年增加了數千個工作機會。

examples.en: The new sports facility includes a pool and two gyms.
examples.zh: 這座新的運動設施包括一座游泳池和兩間健身房。

examples.en: She plays the violin with surprising facility for a beginner.
examples.zh: 以初學者來說，她拉小提琴的技巧好得令人驚訝。

examples.en: The project required a considerable amount of time and money.
examples.zh: 這個專案需要相當多的時間與金錢。

examples.en: There is considerable evidence that exercise improves mood.
examples.zh: 有相當多的證據顯示運動能改善情緒。

examples.en: Every employee made an important contribution to the team's success.
examples.zh: 每位員工都對團隊的成功做出了重要貢獻。

examples.en: He made a generous contribution to the local children's hospital.
examples.zh: 他慷慨捐款給當地的兒童醫院。

examples.en: A large proportion of students walk or bike to school.
examples.zh: 很大比例的學生走路或騎腳踏車上學。

examples.en: Her drawings show a good sense of proportion.
examples.zh: 她的畫作展現出良好的比例感。

examples.en: My employer allows us to work from home twice a week.
examples.zh: 我的僱主允許我們每週在家工作兩天。

examples.en: She asked her former employer for a reference letter.
examples.zh: 她向之前的僱主要了一封推薦信。

examples.en: New legislation will require all cars to pass a safety test.
examples.zh: 新法規將要求所有汽車通過安全檢測。

examples.en: The city passed legislation to protect old trees.
examples.zh: 市政府通過立法來保護老樹。

examples.en: The airline mainly operates domestic flights within Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司主要經營台灣國內航線。

examples.en: They share the domestic chores equally on weekends.
examples.zh: 他們週末平均分擔家務。

examples.en: The editor asked me to shorten the article by two hundred words.
examples.zh: 編輯要求我把文章刪減兩百字。

examples.en: She works as a senior editor at a travel magazine.
examples.zh: 她在一家旅遊雜誌擔任資深編輯。

examples.en: Traveling abroad gave him a fresh perspective on his own culture.
examples.zh: 出國旅行讓他對自己的文化有了全新的看法。

examples.en: From the top of the hill, the houses look small in perspective.
examples.zh: 從山頂望去，房子因透視效果顯得渺小。

examples.en: The company is reviewing its internal rules on data security.
examples.zh: 公司正在檢視其內部的資料安全規定。

examples.en: Doctors found no internal injuries after the accident.
examples.zh: 事故發生後，醫生並未發現內傷。

examples.en: The prize money was divided equally among the four winners.
examples.zh: 獎金由四位得獎者平均分配。

examples.en: Both solutions are equally effective, so choose whichever you like.
examples.zh: 兩種解決方案同樣有效，所以挑你喜歡的就好。

examples.en: Learning a language requires patience and discipline.
examples.zh: 學習語言需要耐心與紀律。

examples.en: Economics is a challenging discipline that rewards careful thinking.
examples.zh: 經濟學是一門需要縝密思考、具有挑戰性的學科。

examples.en: The charity handles the distribution of food to local families.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構負責把食物分配給當地家庭。

examples.en: Researchers studied the distribution of rainfall across the island.
examples.zh: 研究人員研究了全島降雨的分布情形。

examples.en: My knee joint still hurts when I climb stairs.
examples.zh: 我爬樓梯時膝關節還是會痛。

examples.en: The two companies signed a joint agreement to share the research.
examples.zh: 兩家公司簽署了一項共同協議來分享研究成果。

examples.en: After forty years of work, he retired on a comfortable pension.
examples.zh: 工作四十年後，他靠著優渥的退休金退休了。

examples.en: The government raised the pension for elderly farmers this year.
examples.zh: 政府今年提高了老年農民的津貼。

examples.en: The store offers a wide selection of fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 這家店提供種類豐富的新鮮水果。

examples.en: Her selection as team captain surprised no one.
examples.zh: 她被選為隊長，沒有人感到意外。

examples.en: The accident changed her perception of how dangerous driving can be.
examples.zh: 那場意外改變了她對開車有多危險的認知。

examples.en: Public perception of the company improved after the charity event.
examples.zh: 慈善活動後，大眾對該公司的觀感提升了。

examples.en: The contract includes a clause about early termination fees.
examples.zh: 這份合約包含一條關於提前解約費用的條款。

examples.en: In English class, we learned how to identify the main clause.
examples.zh: 在英文課上，我們學會如何辨識主要子句。

examples.en: She moved to Leeds last year for a new job.
examples.zh: 她去年為了新工作搬到里茲。

examples.en: The train from London to Leeds takes about two hours.
examples.zh: 從倫敦到里茲的火車大約需要兩小時。

examples.en: My brother turned nineteen last week.
examples.zh: 我弟弟上週滿十九歲。

examples.en: There are nineteen students in the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室裡有十九位學生。

examples.en: The company accepted liability for the defective product.
examples.zh: 該公司承認對瑕疵產品負有責任。

examples.en: His lack of experience is a liability in this job.
examples.zh: 缺乏經驗是他在這份工作上的劣勢。

examples.en: The discovery has great significance for medical research.
examples.zh: 這項發現對醫學研究具有重大意義。

examples.en: She didn't understand the significance of his silence.
examples.zh: 她不明白他的沉默代表什麼意義。

examples.en: The instructions are specifically designed for beginners.
examples.zh: 這些說明是專門為初學者設計的。

examples.en: He specifically asked for a window seat.
examples.zh: 他特別要求要靠窗的座位。

examples.en: The workers laid a new cable under the street.
examples.zh: 工人們在街道下鋪設了一條新電纜。

examples.en: We couldn't watch the show because the cable was down.
examples.zh: 我們無法收看那個節目，因為有線電視斷訊了。

examples.en: The tenant pays rent on the first day of each month.
examples.zh: 房客在每月一號繳房租。

examples.en: The landlord must give the tenant proper notice before entering.
examples.zh: 房東進入前必須給房客適當的通知。

examples.en: The company dominates the smartphone market in Asia.
examples.zh: 該公司在亞洲智慧型手機市場佔有主導地位。

examples.en: He tends to dominate the conversation at meetings.
examples.zh: 他在會議上往往會主導談話。

examples.en: The buyer agreed to pay the full asking price.
examples.zh: 買方同意支付全額要價。

examples.en: As a buyer, you should compare prices before purchasing.
examples.zh: 作為買家，你應該在購買前比較價格。

examples.en: You could feel the tension in the room before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前你可以感受到房間裡的緊張氣氛。

examples.en: The rope was pulled tight, creating a lot of tension.
examples.zh: 繩子被拉得很緊，產生很大的張力。

examples.en: The prosecutor presented new evidence in court.
examples.zh: 檢察官在法庭上提出新證據。

examples.en: The prosecutor decided to drop the charges.
examples.zh: 檢察官決定撤銷指控。

examples.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget review.
examples.zh: 議程上的第一項是預算審查。

examples.en: She has a hidden agenda for supporting the project.
examples.zh: 她支持這個專案另有隱情。

examples.en: The argument is based on the premise that all people are equal.
examples.zh: 這個論點是基於人人平等的前提。

examples.en: The company is looking for new premises downtown.
examples.zh: 該公司正在市中心尋找新的辦公場所。

examples.en: The city's economy relies heavily on manufacturing.
examples.zh: 該城市的經濟嚴重依賴製造業。

examples.en: Manufacturing jobs have declined in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來製造業的工作機會減少了。

examples.en: The two companies formed a partnership to develop new software.
examples.zh: 兩家公司建立合作關係，共同開發新軟體。

examples.en: Their partnership ended after five years.
examples.zh: 他們的合夥關係在五年後結束。

examples.en: Scientists have identified a gene linked to the disease.
examples.zh: 科學家已找出與該疾病有關的基因。

examples.en: Eye color is determined by more than one gene.
examples.zh: 眼睛的顏色由不只一個基因決定。

examples.en: The remaining guests left after midnight.
examples.zh: 剩下的客人過了午夜才離開。

examples.en: She spent the remaining money on groceries.
examples.zh: 她把剩下的錢花在買菜上。

examples.en: I perceived a slight change in his tone of voice.
examples.zh: 我察覺到他的語氣有細微的變化。

examples.en: Many people perceive him as a strong leader.
examples.zh: 許多人認為他是一位強有力的領導者。

examples.en: The transition from high school to college can be challenging for many students.
examples.zh: 對許多學生來說，從高中到大學的過渡期可能很有挑戰性。

examples.en: Her sudden transition from anger to laughter surprised everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她突然從生氣轉為大笑，讓在場所有人都很驚訝。

examples.en: Your participation in the discussion will help us make a better decision.
examples.zh: 你的參與討論將幫助我們做出更好的決定。

examples.en: The festival relies on the active participation of local volunteers.
examples.zh: 這個節慶依賴當地志工的積極參與。

examples.en: The project met strong resistance from residents who opposed the new road.
examples.zh: 這項計畫遭到反對新道路的居民強烈抵制。

examples.en: Regular exercise can improve your resistance to illness.
examples.zh: 規律運動可以增強你對疾病的抵抗力。

examples.en: The new restriction on outdoor water use will start next month.
examples.zh: 戶外用水的新限制將從下個月開始實施。

examples.en: There is a restriction on the number of guests you can invite.
examples.zh: 你能邀請的賓客人數有限制。

examples.en: She prefers conventional teaching methods over the latest online tools.
examples.zh: 她比較喜歡傳統的教學方法，而不是最新的線上工具。

examples.en: The couple chose a conventional wedding ceremony in a small church.
examples.zh: 這對情侶選擇在小教堂舉行傳統的婚禮。

examples.en: He made a voluntary decision to help clean up the park.
examples.zh: 他自願決定幫忙清理公園。

examples.en: Participation in the survey is completely voluntary.
examples.zh: 參與這項調查完全是自願的。

examples.en: Please provide your input on the new design before Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五之前對新設計提供你的意見。

examples.en: The computer needs more input from the keyboard to process the command.
examples.zh: 電腦需要從鍵盤輸入更多資料才能處理指令。

examples.en: The two plans are essentially the same, except for a few details.
examples.zh: 這兩個計畫本質上相同，只有一些細節不同。

examples.en: Her job is essentially about helping people solve their problems.
examples.zh: 她的工作本質上就是幫助人們解決問題。

examples.en: Strict enforcement of the traffic rules has reduced accidents in the city.
examples.zh: 嚴格執行交通規則減少了城市的交通事故。

examples.en: The agency is responsible for the enforcement of environmental laws.
examples.zh: 該機構負責環境法律的執行。

examples.en: The intense heat made it difficult to work outside.
examples.zh: 強烈的高溫讓人很難在戶外工作。

examples.en: She felt intense pressure before the final exam.
examples.zh: 她在期末考前面臨極大的壓力。

examples.en: The congressional committee will review the proposed budget next week.
examples.zh: 國會委員會將於下週審查擬議的預算。

examples.en: A congressional hearing was held to discuss the new policy.
examples.zh: 舉行了一場國會聽證會來討論新政策。

examples.en: Adding fresh herbs can enhance the flavor of the soup.
examples.zh: 加入新鮮香草可以提升湯的風味。

examples.en: The company hopes to enhance its image by improving customer service.
examples.zh: 公司希望透過改善客戶服務來提升形象。

examples.en: Teachers evaluate students' progress through tests and projects.
examples.zh: 老師透過考試和專案來評估學生的進步。

examples.en: We need to evaluate the risks before starting the project.
examples.zh: 我們需要在開始專案之前評估風險。

examples.en: The maker of the popular toy announced a recall due to safety issues.
examples.zh: 這款熱門玩具的製造商因安全問題宣布召回。

examples.en: As a decision maker, she must consider all the options carefully.
examples.zh: 作為決策者，她必須仔細考慮所有選項。

examples.en: The two companies formed an alliance to develop new technology.
examples.zh: 兩家公司結成聯盟來開發新技術。

examples.en: Their alliance was based on shared business interests.
examples.zh: 他們的聯盟建立在共同的商業利益上。

examples.en: The rapid expansion of the city has led to more traffic problems.
examples.zh: 城市的快速擴張導致了更多交通問題。

examples.en: The company's expansion into overseas markets was a success.
examples.zh: 公司擴展到海外市場是成功的。

examples.en: The psychological effects of the accident lasted for months.
examples.zh: 那場事故的心理影響持續了好幾個月。

examples.en: She is studying the psychological reasons behind consumer behavior.
examples.zh: 她正在研究消費者行為背後的心理原因。

examples.en: The ratio of students to teachers in this school is 15 to 1.
examples.zh: 這所學校的學生與教師比例是15比1。

examples.en: A high ratio of debt to income can be a financial risk.
examples.zh: 高負債對收入比率可能是一種財務風險。

examples.en: The defense system is designed to intercept incoming missiles.
examples.zh: 防禦系統旨在攔截來襲的飛彈。

examples.en: The missile was launched from a remote location.
examples.zh: 飛彈從一個偏遠地點發射。

examples.en: The heart has four chambers that pump blood throughout the body.
examples.zh: 心臟有四個腔室，將血液泵送到全身。

examples.en: The judge entered the chamber to review the documents.
examples.zh: 法官進入議事室審查文件。

examples.en: The gold and silver medals went to Japan and Korea, respectively.
examples.zh: 金牌和銀牌分別由日本和韓國獲得。

examples.en: Please write your name and phone number in the first and second boxes, respectively.
examples.zh: 請分別在第一個和第二個方框中填寫您的姓名和電話號碼。

examples.en: The hotel was reasonably priced and close to the train station.
examples.zh: 這家飯店價格相當合理，而且離火車站很近。

examples.en: She reasonably argued that the deadline should be extended.
examples.zh: 她合理地主張截止日期應該延長。

examples.en: There is no indication that the weather will improve tomorrow.
examples.zh: 沒有跡象顯示明天天氣會好轉。

examples.en: The doctor said the fever was an indication of infection.
examples.zh: 醫生說發燒是感染的徵兆。

examples.en: Her testimony in court helped convict the thief.
examples.zh: 她在法庭上的證詞幫助將小偷定罪。

examples.en: The broken window was testimony to the force of the storm.
examples.zh: 破損的窗戶是暴風雨威力的證據。

examples.en: Volunteers distributed food and water to the flood victims.
examples.zh: 志工們向水災災民分發食物和水。

examples.en: The company plans to distribute its new software worldwide.
examples.zh: 該公司計劃在全球發行其新軟體。

examples.en: If you keep spending more than you earn, you will inevitably fall into debt.
examples.zh: 如果你一直入不敷出，不可避免地會陷入債務。

examples.en: Inevitably, the discussion turned to the upcoming election.
examples.zh: 討論不可避免地轉向了即將到來的選舉。

examples.en: The building has ramps and elevators for disabled visitors.
examples.zh: 這棟建築有供身心障礙訪客使用的坡道和電梯。

examples.en: He became disabled after a car accident but still lives independently.
examples.zh: 他在車禍後成為身心障礙者，但仍獨立生活。

examples.en: The ownership of the land was transferred to the new owner.
examples.zh: 這塊土地的所有權已轉移給新主人。

examples.en: They take pride in the ownership of their small business.
examples.zh: 他們為自己擁有這家小企業感到自豪。

examples.en: The company made a strategic decision to enter the Asian market.
examples.zh: 該公司做出了進入亞洲市場的戰略決定。

examples.en: This port is strategically located for trade with Europe.
examples.zh: 這個港口位於與歐洲貿易的戰略位置。

examples.en: We need more storage space for all these books.
examples.zh: 我們需要更多儲存空間來放這些書。

examples.en: The warehouse provides storage for imported goods.
examples.zh: 這個倉庫提供進口貨物的儲存。

examples.en: Please write a brief summary of the article in English.
examples.zh: 請用英文寫一篇這篇文章的簡短摘要。

examples.en: The summary of the report highlighted the main findings.
examples.zh: 報告的摘要強調了主要發現。

examples.en: You can find the price of each item in the catalogue.
examples.zh: 你可以在目錄中找到每件商品的價格。

examples.en: The librarian catalogued the new books by subject.
examples.zh: 圖書館員按主題將新書編入目錄。

examples.en: The publisher decided to release the novel in paperback.
examples.zh: 出版社決定以平裝本發行這本小說。

examples.en: She sent her manuscript to several publishers before finding one.
examples.zh: 她把她的手稿寄給了好幾家出版社，最後才找到一家。

examples.en: The dictator showed no ruth in suppressing dissent.
examples.zh: 那個獨裁者在鎮壓異議時毫不留情。

examples.en: With ruth, the invaders destroyed the ancient city.
examples.zh: 侵略者殘忍地摧毀了這座古城。

examples.en: The theoretical framework of the study is based on quantum mechanics.
examples.zh: 這項研究的理論框架基於量子力學。

examples.en: In theory, the plan sounds good, but theoretical models often fail in practice.
examples.zh: 理論上，這個計劃聽起來不錯，但理論模型在實踐中常常失敗。

examples.en: The children screamed in terror when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 燈熄滅時，孩子們恐懼地尖叫。

examples.en: He was the terror of the neighborhood, always causing trouble.
examples.zh: 他是社區裡的恐怖分子，總是惹麻煩。

examples.en: The implementation of the new policy will begin next month.
examples.zh: 新政策的實施將於下個月開始。

examples.en: Successful implementation of the software requires careful planning.
examples.zh: 該軟體的成功實施需要仔細規劃。

examples.en: She walked alongside the river, enjoying the cool breeze.
examples.zh: 她沿著河邊散步，享受涼爽的微風。

examples.en: The new building stands alongside the old library.
examples.zh: 新建築與舊圖書館並排而立。

examples.en: We need a replacement for the broken printer.
examples.zh: 我們需要一台替換的印表機來取代壞掉的那台。

examples.en: The manager hired a replacement while she was on maternity leave.
examples.zh: 經理在她休產假期間僱用了一名替代人員。

examples.en: The chart shows the company's sales over the past five years.
examples.zh: 這張圖表顯示了公司過去五年的銷售額。

examples.en: The sailors used a chart to navigate through the dangerous waters.
examples.zh: 水手們使用海圖在危險水域中航行。

examples.en: The frequency of buses on this route increases during rush hour.
examples.zh: 這條路線的公車在尖峰時段班次頻率會增加。

examples.en: Researchers recorded the frequency of each bird species in the forest.
examples.zh: 研究人員記錄了森林中每種鳥類出現的頻率。

examples.en: As an educator, she believes every child can learn with the right support.
examples.zh: 身為教育家，她相信每個孩子只要得到適當的支持都能學習。

examples.en: The conference brought together educators from across the country.
examples.zh: 這場會議聚集了來自全國各地的教育家。

examples.en: Immigration has shaped the culture and economy of many nations.
examples.zh: 移民對許多國家的文化和經濟產生了深遠的影響。

examples.en: The government announced new policies to manage immigration more effectively.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了新政策，以更有效地管理移民。

examples.en: The duke owned vast lands and lived in a grand castle.
examples.zh: 這位公爵擁有廣大的土地，並住在宏偉的城堡裡。

examples.en: She was invited to dine with the duke at his estate.
examples.zh: 她受邀到公爵的莊園與他共進晚餐。

examples.en: The report offers a comprehensive analysis of the market trends.
examples.zh: 這份報告對市場趨勢提供了全面的分析。

examples.en: Students must pass a comprehensive exam before graduation.
examples.zh: 學生必須在畢業前通過一項綜合考試。

examples.en: The car dealer offered a discount if we paid in cash.
examples.zh: 汽車經銷商表示如果我們付現就給折扣。

examples.en: He works as an art dealer, selling paintings to private collectors.
examples.zh: 他是一名藝術品經銷商，將畫作賣給私人收藏家。

examples.en: The company was fined for a breach of safety regulations.
examples.zh: 該公司因違反安全法規而被罰款。

examples.en: The soldiers tried to breach the enemy's defenses at dawn.
examples.zh: 士兵們在黎明時試圖攻破敵人的防線。

examples.en: The young lad helped his father carry the boxes into the house.
examples.zh: 這個少年幫父親把箱子搬進屋裡。

examples.en: A group of lads were playing football in the park.
examples.zh: 一群小伙子在公園裡踢足球。

examples.en: The scope of the project was much larger than we initially thought.
examples.zh: 這個專案的範圍比我們最初想像的大得多。

examples.en: The telescope's scope allows us to see distant galaxies clearly.
examples.zh: 這台望遠鏡的鏡頭讓我們能清楚地看到遙遠的星系。

examples.en: Please read the first paragraph and summarize its main idea.
examples.zh: 請閱讀第一段並總結其主要觀點。

examples.en: She decided to paragraph the essay into three clear sections.
examples.zh: 她決定將這篇文章分成三個清晰的部分。

examples.en: Washing your hands frequently can help prevent infection.
examples.zh: 經常洗手有助於預防感染。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the infection.
examples.zh: 醫生開了抗生素來治療感染。

examples.en: The electrician checked the circuit to find the faulty wire.
examples.zh: 電工檢查了電路以找出故障的電線。

examples.en: The race car completed ten circuits of the track.
examples.zh: 賽車在跑道上完成了十圈。

examples.en: The historian spent years studying ancient manuscripts.
examples.zh: 這位歷史學家花了數年時間研究古代手稿。

examples.en: According to one historian, the city was founded in the 12th century.
examples.zh: 根據一位歷史學家的說法，這座城市建於十二世紀。

examples.en: The biological differences between the two species are subtle.
examples.zh: 這兩個物種之間的生物學差異很細微。

examples.en: She decided to trace her biological parents after many years.
examples.zh: 多年後她決定尋找自己的親生父母。

examples.en: The peasant worked hard in the fields from sunrise to sunset.
examples.zh: 這位農夫從日出到日落都在田裡辛勤工作。

examples.en: In the story, a poor peasant discovered a magic lamp.
examples.zh: 故事中，一位貧窮的農夫發現了一盞神燈。

examples.en: I assure you that your order will arrive by Friday.
examples.zh: 我向你保證你的訂單會在週五前送達。

examples.en: The manager assured the team that their jobs were safe.
examples.zh: 經理向團隊保證他們的工作不會受到影響。

examples.en: The drug is still undergoing clinical trials.
examples.zh: 這種藥物仍在進行臨床試驗。

examples.en: Her clinical approach to the problem impressed the committee.
examples.zh: 她對問題冷靜客觀的處理方式讓委員會印象深刻。

examples.en: She fell and hurt her hip while skiing.
examples.zh: 她滑雪時摔倒傷到了臀部。

examples.en: The doctor examined the patient's hip joint carefully.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細檢查了病人的髖關節。

examples.en: The company is looking for a new supplier of raw materials.
examples.zh: 該公司正在尋找新的原料供應商。

examples.en: Our supplier promised to deliver the goods by Monday.
examples.zh: 我們的供應商承諾在週一前交貨。

examples.en: The company reported higher earnings this quarter than last year.
examples.zh: 該公司報告本季收益比去年更高。

examples.en: He saved a portion of his earnings for retirement.
examples.zh: 他將一部分收入存起來以備退休之用。

examples.en: My sister loves outdoor activities, whereas I prefer staying home with a good book.
examples.zh: 我妹妹熱愛戶外活動，而我則喜歡待在家裡讀一本好書。

examples.en: Whereas the old system was slow and unreliable, the new one is fast and efficient.
examples.zh: 舊系統既慢又不可靠，而新系統則快速又有效率。

examples.en: The concentration of salt in seawater is about 3.5 percent.
examples.zh: 海水中鹽的濃度大約是百分之三點五。

examples.en: Playing video games requires intense concentration, so turn off your phone.
examples.zh: 玩電動遊戲需要高度專注，所以把你的手機關掉。

examples.en: The corporate headquarters are located in the city center.
examples.zh: 公司總部設在市中心。

examples.en: She adopted a corporate image by wearing a suit to the interview.
examples.zh: 她穿西裝去面試，塑造出企業形象。

examples.en: The two countries finally reached a peaceful settlement after years of talks.
examples.zh: 經過多年會談，兩國終於達成和平解決方案。

examples.en: The first European settlement in the area was established in the 17th century.
examples.zh: 該地區第一個歐洲殖民地在十七世紀建立。

examples.en: A recent poll shows that most voters support the new policy.
examples.zh: 最近一項民意調查顯示，大多數選民支持這項新政策。

examples.en: The horse had a white mark on its poll.
examples.zh: 那匹馬的頭頂有一個白色斑點。

examples.en: We followed a narrow trail through the forest to reach the waterfall.
examples.zh: 我們沿著森林中一條狹窄的小徑走到瀑布。

examples.en: The dog trailed behind its owner, sniffing everything along the way.
examples.zh: 那隻狗跟在主人後面，沿途聞遍所有東西。

examples.en: The publication of her first novel brought her instant fame.
examples.zh: 她的第一部小說出版後，讓她一舉成名。

examples.en: This magazine is a monthly publication featuring travel stories.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌是每月出版的刊物，以旅遊故事為主題。

examples.en: The government plans to increase expenditure on public healthcare.
examples.zh: 政府計畫增加公共醫療保健的支出。

examples.en: Keeping a budget helps you track your monthly expenditure.
examples.zh: 記帳可以幫助你追蹤每月的開支。

examples.en: The company's annual revenue grew by 15 percent last year.
examples.zh: 該公司去年的年收入成長了百分之十五。

examples.en: The government collects revenue through various taxes.
examples.zh: 政府透過各種稅收來徵集歲入。

examples.en: We spent the afternoon admiring paintings at the art gallery.
examples.zh: 我們在美術館度過一個下午欣賞畫作。

examples.en: The old mansion has a long gallery lined with portraits.
examples.zh: 這座老宅有一條長廊，兩側掛滿了肖像畫。

examples.en: Safety is our top priority when designing new products.
examples.zh: 設計新產品時，安全是我們的首要任務。

examples.en: You need to set priorities and focus on what matters most.
examples.zh: 你需要設定優先順序，並專注於最重要的事。

examples.en: My parents are quite liberal and allow me to make my own decisions.
examples.zh: 我父母相當開明，允許我自己做決定。

examples.en: The university is known for its liberal approach to education.
examples.zh: 這所大學以其自由主義的教育方針聞名。

examples.en: It was apparent from her smile that she had good news.
examples.zh: 從她的笑容明顯看出她有好消息。

examples.en: The apparent calm of the lake hid a strong current beneath.
examples.zh: 湖面看似平靜，卻暗藏強勁的水流。

examples.en: After many delays, the project was ultimately completed on time.
examples.zh: 經過多次延誤，這個專案最終還是準時完成了。

examples.en: Ultimately, the decision is yours to make.
examples.zh: 最終，這個決定還是由你來做。

examples.en: A large percentage of students walk or bike to school.
examples.zh: 很大比例的學生走路或騎腳踏車上學。

examples.en: What percentage of your income do you save each month?
examples.zh: 你每個月存下收入的百分之幾？

examples.en: Regular exercise is vital for maintaining good health.
examples.zh: 規律運動對維持身體健康至關重要。

examples.en: The nurse checked the patient's vital signs every hour.
examples.zh: 護士每小時檢查病人的生命徵象。

examples.en: She decided to study engineering because she loves solving problems.
examples.zh: 她決定攻讀工程學，因為她熱愛解決問題。

examples.en: The bridge is a masterpiece of modern engineering.
examples.zh: 這座橋是現代工程的傑作。

examples.en: King Henry III ruled England in the 13th century.
examples.zh: 亨利三世在十三世紀統治英格蘭。

examples.en: The meeting is scheduled for 3:00 p.m. on May iii.
examples.zh: 會議預定在五月三日（羅馬數字）下午三點舉行。

examples.en: The new regime promised to improve the economy and reduce poverty.
examples.zh: 新政權承諾改善經濟並減少貧窮。

examples.en: The doctor put him on a strict dietary regime to lower his cholesterol.
examples.zh: 醫生要他嚴格遵守飲食制度來降低膽固醇。

examples.en: There is a clear distinction between being confident and being arrogant.
examples.zh: 自信與自大之間有明顯的區別。

examples.en: She graduated with distinction from the university.
examples.zh: 她以優異成績從大學畢業。

examples.en: The senator proposed a new bill to improve public education.
examples.zh: 這位參議員提出了一項改善公共教育的新法案。

examples.en: She interviewed the senator about the upcoming election.
examples.zh: 她就即將到來的選舉採訪了這位參議員。

examples.en: Firstly, we need to cut costs; secondly, we must increase sales.
examples.zh: 首先，我們需要降低成本；其次，我們必須增加銷售。

examples.en: Secondly, the report fails to address the environmental impact.
examples.zh: 其次，該報告未能處理環境影響的問題。

examples.en: They moved to a quiet residential area near the park.
examples.zh: 他們搬到公園附近一個安靜的住宅區。

examples.en: The city plans to build more residential buildings downtown.
examples.zh: 市政府計劃在市中心建造更多住宅建築。

examples.en: The two leaders engaged in a constructive dialogue about trade.
examples.zh: 兩位領導人就貿易進行了建設性的對話。

examples.en: The movie's dialogue was witty and fast-paced.
examples.zh: 這部電影的對白機智且節奏明快。

examples.en: The team showed great unity during the difficult project.
examples.zh: 團隊在這個困難的專案中展現了極大的團結。

examples.en: Cultural unity can be achieved without losing diversity.
examples.zh: 文化統一可以在不失去多樣性的情況下達成。

examples.en: The company's annual turnover exceeded one billion dollars.
examples.zh: 該公司的年營業額超過十億美元。

examples.en: High staff turnover is a major concern for management.
examples.zh: 員工流動率高是管理層的一大隱憂。

examples.en: The plan is too expensive; furthermore, it may not work.
examples.zh: 這個計畫太昂貴了；此外，它可能行不通。

examples.en: Furthermore, the study found no evidence to support the claim.
examples.zh: 此外，該研究沒有發現支持該主張的證據。

examples.en: The city is home to people from diverse cultural backgrounds.
examples.zh: 這座城市有來自不同文化背景的人們。

examples.en: Her diverse interests range from painting to astronomy.
examples.zh: 她多樣的興趣從繪畫到天文學都有。

examples.en: The company's headquarters are located in Taipei.
examples.zh: 該公司的總部設在台北。

examples.en: Police headquarters issued a statement about the incident.
examples.zh: 警察總部就該事件發表了一份聲明。

examples.en: She walked down the long corridor to the conference room.
examples.zh: 她沿著長走廊走到會議室。

examples.en: The hotel corridor was dimly lit and quiet.
examples.zh: 飯店的走廊燈光昏暗且安靜。

examples.en: The principal made an announcement about the school trip.
examples.zh: 校長宣布了關於學校旅行的消息。

examples.en: We heard an important announcement on the radio.
examples.zh: 我們在收音機上聽到一則重要的公告。

examples.en: He has been unemployed since the factory closed last year.
examples.zh: 自從工廠去年關閉以來，他就一直失業。

examples.en: The government offers training programs for unemployed workers.
examples.zh: 政府為失業工人提供培訓計畫。

examples.en: She drew an outline of the mountain before painting it.
examples.zh: 她在畫山之前先畫了山的輪廓。

examples.en: The professor gave us an outline of the course syllabus.
examples.zh: 教授給了我們課程大綱的概要。

examples.en: The book offers valuable insights into human behavior.
examples.zh: 這本書對人類行為提供了寶貴的見解。

examples.en: Her research gave us new insight into the disease.
examples.zh: 她的研究讓我們對這種疾病有了新的洞察。

examples.en: The sergeant ordered his troops to stand at attention.
examples.zh: 中士命令他的部隊立正站好。

examples.en: A police sergeant arrived at the scene within minutes.
examples.zh: 一位警察小隊長在幾分鐘內到達現場。

examples.en: When I asked him why, he just shrugged his shoulders.
examples.zh: 當我問他為什麼時，他只是聳了聳肩。

examples.en: She gave a shrug and said she didn't care.
examples.zh: 她聳了聳肩說她不在乎。

examples.en: Tourists flock to the cathedral to admire its stained glass.
examples.zh: 遊客湧入這座大教堂欣賞它的彩繪玻璃。

examples.en: The old cathedral stands in the center of the city.
examples.zh: 這座古老的大教堂矗立在市中心。

examples.en: She is a prominent figure in the field of artificial intelligence.
examples.zh: 她是人工智慧領域的傑出人物。

examples.en: The building has a prominent position on the skyline.
examples.zh: 這棟建築在天際線上佔有顯著的位置。

examples.en: Please confine your remarks to the topic under discussion.
examples.zh: 請將你的發言限制在討論的主題上。

examples.en: The injured hiker was confined to bed for a week.
examples.zh: 受傷的登山客在床上休養了一週。

examples.en: The decision was made purely on the basis of cost.
examples.zh: 這項決定純粹是基於成本考量。

examples.en: It was purely by chance that we met at the airport.
examples.zh: 我們在機場相遇純粹是巧合。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a remedy for my persistent cough.
examples.zh: 醫生開了一種藥來治療我持續不斷的咳嗽。

examples.en: They worked hard to remedy the damage caused by the flood.
examples.zh: 他們努力補救洪水造成的損害。

examples.en: The Gulf of Mexico is known for its warm waters.
examples.zh: 墨西哥灣以其溫暖的海水而聞名。

examples.en: There is a growing gulf between the rich and the poor.
examples.zh: 貧富之間的隔閡日益擴大。

examples.en: His offensive remarks upset everyone at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他冒犯性的言論讓會議上的每個人都感到不安。

examples.en: The army launched an offensive against the enemy base.
examples.zh: 軍隊對敵方基地發動了攻擊。

examples.en: The loud boom of the fireworks startled the children.
examples.zh: 煙火的巨大隆隆聲嚇到了孩子們。

examples.en: The tech industry is experiencing a boom in recent years.
examples.zh: 科技產業近年來正經歷繁榮。

examples.en: The street vendor sells fresh fruit every morning.
examples.zh: 街頭小販每天早上賣新鮮水果。

examples.en: We bought the software from an authorized vendor.
examples.zh: 我們從授權的銷售商那裡購買了這個軟體。

examples.en: The automatic doors open when you approach them.
examples.zh: 當你靠近時，自動門會打開。

examples.en: She gave an automatic reply without thinking.
examples.zh: 她未經思考就機械式地回答了。

examples.en: New students attend an orientation to learn about the campus.
examples.zh: 新生參加迎新說明會以了解校園環境。

examples.en: The orientation of the building allows it to receive maximum sunlight.
examples.zh: 這棟建築的方位讓它能接收到最多的陽光。

examples.en: The painting depicts a peaceful countryside scene.
examples.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一個寧靜的鄉村景色。

examples.en: The novel depicts life in the 19th century.
examples.zh: 這本小說描述了19世紀的生活。

examples.en: Eating enough fibre is important for good digestion.
examples.zh: 攝取足夠的纖維對良好的消化很重要。

examples.en: The nerve fibre carries signals to the brain.
examples.zh: 神經纖維將訊號傳遞到大腦。

examples.en: The government imposed sanctions on the country.
examples.zh: 政府對該國實施了制裁。

examples.en: The project received official sanction from the authorities.
examples.zh: 該項目獲得了當局的正式批准。

examples.en: The declaration of independence was signed in 1776.
examples.zh: 獨立宣言於1776年簽署。

examples.en: She made a declaration of her love for him.
examples.zh: 她公開聲明了她對他的愛。

examples.en: Please bring a valid identification to the interview.
examples.zh: 請攜帶有效的身份證明文件參加面試。

examples.en: The identification of the suspect was confirmed by witnesses.
examples.zh: 證人確認了嫌疑犯的身份。

examples.en: They were married in a small chapel in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他們在鄉間的一座小教堂結婚。

examples.en: The chapel service was held every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 每個星期天早上都舉行禮拜儀式。

examples.en: The youngster played soccer with his friends.
examples.zh: 那個少年和朋友們一起踢足球。

examples.en: Several youngsters volunteered to help clean the park.
examples.zh: 幾位年輕人自願幫忙打掃公園。

examples.en: She applied powder to her face before the party.
examples.zh: 她在派對前在臉上搽了粉。

examples.en: The recipe calls for a teaspoon of baking powder.
examples.zh: 這個食譜需要一茶匙的泡打粉。

examples.en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 一個水分子由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成。

examples.en: Scientists studied the molecule to understand its properties.
examples.zh: 科學家研究這個分子以了解其特性。

examples.en: They spent their vacation on a beautiful isle in the Pacific.
examples.zh: 他們在太平洋上一個美麗的小島度過假期。

examples.en: The isle is home to many rare birds.
examples.zh: 這個小島是許多稀有鳥類的棲息地。

examples.en: She packed a first-aid kit for the hiking trip.
examples.zh: 她為健行之旅準備了一個急救箱。

examples.en: The mechanic opened his tool kit to fix the engine.
examples.zh: 技師打開他的工具箱來修理引擎。

examples.en: After her parents passed away, her aunt became her legal guardian.
examples.zh: 她的父母過世後，阿姨成為她的法定監護人。

examples.en: The museum serves as a guardian of the city's cultural heritage.
examples.zh: 這座博物館扮演著城市文化遺產守護者的角色。

examples.en: The new software has the capability to process thousands of files at once.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體有能力一次處理數千個檔案。

examples.en: Scientists are studying the brain's capability for learning new languages.
examples.zh: 科學家正在研究大腦學習新語言的能力。

examples.en: The film received a lot of publicity before it was released.
examples.zh: 這部影片在上映前獲得了大量宣傳。

examples.en: She hired a publicist to handle publicity for her new book.
examples.zh: 她聘請了一位公關人員來處理新書的宣傳事宜。

examples.en: The weary traveller stopped at a small inn for the night.
examples.zh: 疲憊的旅行者在一家小旅館停下來過夜。

examples.en: As a frequent traveller, he always packs light.
examples.zh: 身為經常旅行的人，他總是輕裝上路。

examples.en: The restaurant offers sophisticated dishes made with fresh local ingredients.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳提供以新鮮本地食材製作的精緻菜餚。

examples.en: She has sophisticated tastes in art and music.
examples.zh: 她在藝術和音樂方面有高雅的品味。

examples.en: The town is famous for its well-preserved medieval castle.
examples.zh: 這座小鎮以其保存完好的中世紀城堡聞名。

examples.en: Medieval manuscripts are carefully stored in the library's vault.
examples.zh: 中世紀的手稿被小心地保存在圖書館的保險庫中。

examples.en: The completion of the bridge was delayed by bad weather.
examples.zh: 這座橋的完工因惡劣天氣而延遲。

examples.en: Upon completion of the course, students will receive a certificate.
examples.zh: 完成課程後，學生將獲得證書。

examples.en: They signed a two-year lease for the apartment.
examples.zh: 他們簽了這間公寓的兩年租約。

examples.en: The company decided to lease rather than buy new computers.
examples.zh: 公司決定租用而不是購買新電腦。

examples.en: She studied accounting in college and now works for a large firm.
examples.zh: 她大學主修會計，現在在一家大公司工作。

examples.en: Proper accounting is essential for any business to succeed.
examples.zh: 妥善的會計對任何企業的成功都至關重要。

examples.en: The closure of the factory left many workers unemployed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉導致許多工人失業。

examples.en: The road closure will last until the repairs are finished.
examples.zh: 道路封閉將持續到維修完成。

examples.en: Please format your essay according to the guidelines.
examples.zh: 請按照指南格式化你的文章。

examples.en: The meeting will follow a specific format: presentation, discussion, and Q&A.
examples.zh: 會議將遵循特定格式：簡報、討論和問答。

examples.en: Adopting a healthy lifestyle can reduce the risk of heart disease.
examples.zh: 採取健康的生活方式可以降低心臟病的風險。

examples.en: Their lifestyle is very different from ours.
examples.zh: 他們的生活方式與我們的非常不同。

examples.en: She gave a prompt reply to my email.
examples.zh: 她迅速回覆了我的電子郵件。

examples.en: The teacher's question prompted a lively discussion.
examples.zh: 老師的問題引發了熱烈的討論。

examples.en: Eating too much fried food can raise your cholesterol.
examples.zh: 吃太多油炸食物會提高你的膽固醇。

examples.en: The doctor advised him to monitor his cholesterol levels.
examples.zh: 醫生建議他監測自己的膽固醇水平。

examples.en: Every taxpayer must file a return by the end of April.
examples.zh: 每位納稅人必須在四月底前申報所得稅。

examples.en: The new policy aims to reduce the burden on taxpayers.
examples.zh: 新政策旨在減輕納稅人的負擔。

examples.en: Without motivation, it's hard to achieve your goals.
examples.zh: 沒有動機，就很難達成目標。

examples.en: Her motivation for volunteering is to help others.
examples.zh: 她志願服務的動機是幫助他人。

examples.en: The experimental drug showed promising results in early trials.
examples.zh: 這種實驗性藥物在早期試驗中顯示出令人鼓舞的結果。

examples.en: They used an experimental method to test the hypothesis.
examples.zh: 他們使用實驗方法來檢驗假設。

examples.en: The internet was a revolutionary invention that changed the world.
examples.zh: 網際網路是一項改變世界的革命性發明。

examples.en: Revolutionary leaders inspired people to fight for freedom.
examples.zh: 革命領袖激勵人們為自由而戰。

examples.en: Dust particles in the air can cause allergies.
examples.zh: 空氣中的灰塵顆粒可能引起過敏。

examples.en: Physicists study subatomic particles like electrons and protons.
examples.zh: 物理學家研究電子、質子等次原子粒子。

examples.en: The team performed well, notably in the second half.
examples.zh: 這支球隊表現出色，尤其是在下半場。

examples.en: Several countries, notably Japan and Germany, have aging populations.
examples.zh: 幾個國家，特別是日本和德國，人口正在老化。

examples.en: The song has a catchy rhythm that makes everyone want to dance.
examples.zh: 這首歌有輕快的節奏，讓每個人都想跳舞。

examples.en: She tapped her foot to the rhythm of the music.
examples.zh: 她用腳打著音樂的節拍。

examples.en: The transformation of the old factory into a museum took two years.
examples.zh: 將舊工廠改造成博物館花了兩年時間。

examples.en: His transformation from a shy boy to a confident speaker amazed everyone.
examples.zh: 他從害羞男孩轉變成自信的演講者，讓大家都很驚訝。

examples.en: Organic farming avoids the use of chemical pesticides.
examples.zh: 有機農業避免使用化學農藥。

examples.en: They moved to the countryside to take up farming.
examples.zh: 他們搬到鄉下從事農業。

examples.en: The headline in today's newspaper caught my attention.
examples.zh: 今天報紙的頭條標題吸引了我的注意。

examples.en: The editor decided to headline the story about the rescue.
examples.zh: 編輯決定將那則救援故事作為頭條。

examples.en: The invasion of the small country was condemned by many nations.
examples.zh: 對這個小國的入侵受到許多國家的譴責。

examples.en: The doctor explained that the invasion of bacteria caused the infection.
examples.zh: 醫生解釋說細菌的侵入造成了感染。

examples.en: The exam was difficult; nonetheless, she passed with a high score.
examples.zh: 考試很難，儘管如此，她還是以高分通過了。

examples.en: He was tired; nonetheless, he finished the project on time.
examples.zh: 他很累，不過他還是按時完成了專案。

examples.en: The quarterback threw a long pass to the receiver.
examples.zh: 四分衛傳了一個長傳給接球員。

examples.en: He dreams of playing quarterback for a professional team.
examples.zh: 他夢想為職業球隊擔任四分衛。

examples.en: The removal of the old furniture made the room look bigger.
examples.zh: 移除舊家具讓房間看起來更大。

examples.en: The doctor recommended the removal of the tumor.
examples.zh: 醫生建議切除腫瘤。

examples.en: The interior of the house was painted in warm colors.
examples.zh: 房子的內部漆成溫暖的顏色。

examples.en: The minister of the interior visited the flood-stricken area.
examples.zh: 內政部長視察了洪水災區。

examples.en: The company plans to recruit more engineers next year.
examples.zh: 公司計劃明年招募更多工程師。

examples.en: The army recruited young men from the village.
examples.zh: 軍隊從村裡招募年輕人。

examples.en: I am wholly convinced that she is telling the truth.
examples.zh: 我完全相信她說的是實話。

examples.en: The project was wholly funded by private donations.
examples.zh: 這個專案完全由私人捐款資助。

examples.en: The accident rendered him unable to walk for months.
examples.zh: 那場事故使他幾個月無法走路。

examples.en: The artist rendered the landscape in watercolors.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家用水彩描繪了風景。

examples.en: She was formally introduced to the board of directors.
examples.zh: 她被正式介紹給董事會。

examples.en: The agreement was formally signed by both parties.
examples.zh: 協議由雙方正式簽署。

examples.en: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
examples.zh: 沒有什麼能誘使他改變主意。

examples.en: The doctor decided to induce labor because of complications.
examples.zh: 由於併發症，醫生決定引產。

examples.en: She had a healthy pregnancy and gave birth to a baby girl.
examples.zh: 她懷孕過程健康，生下了一個女嬰。

examples.en: Regular exercise during pregnancy can benefit both mother and baby.
examples.zh: 懷孕期間規律運動對母親和嬰兒都有好處。

examples.en: The managing director will announce the new policy tomorrow.
examples.zh: 總經理將於明天宣布新政策。

examples.en: She is managing a team of ten people.
examples.zh: 她正在管理一個十人團隊。

examples.en: This website is in the public domain.
examples.zh: 這個網站屬於公共領域。

examples.en: The king ruled over a vast domain.
examples.zh: 國王統治著廣闊的領地。

examples.en: The school aims to integrate technology into every classroom.
examples.zh: 學校的目標是將科技整合到每個教室。

examples.en: It took time for the immigrants to integrate into the community.
examples.zh: 移民融入社區需要時間。

examples.en: The police officer carried a billy club for protection.
examples.zh: 警察攜帶警棍自衛。

examples.en: The billy goat grazed on the hillside.
examples.zh: 公山羊在山坡上吃草。

examples.en: She works in publishing and edits children's books.
examples.zh: 她在出版業工作，編輯兒童書籍。

examples.en: The publishing industry has changed greatly with digital technology.
examples.zh: 出版業因數位技術而發生了巨大變化。

examples.en: Please store the leftovers in an airtight container.
examples.zh: 請將剩菜存放在密封容器中。

examples.en: The cargo ship carries hundreds of containers across the ocean.
examples.zh: 這艘貨船載運數百個貨櫃橫越海洋。

examples.en: The difference in quality between the two products is marginal.
examples.zh: 這兩項產品的品質差異微乎其微。

examples.en: She wrote some marginal notes in the margins of the book.
examples.zh: 她在書的頁邊寫了一些旁註。

examples.en: The truck was carrying over ten tonnes of gravel.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車載運了超過十公噸的礫石。

examples.en: A metric tonne equals one thousand kilograms.
examples.zh: 一公噸等於一千公斤。

examples.en: The government regulates the sale of tobacco to minors.
examples.zh: 政府管制對未成年人販售菸品。

examples.en: This valve regulates the water pressure in the pipes.
examples.zh: 這個閥門調節管線中的水壓。

examples.en: He picked up the receiver and dialed the number.
examples.zh: 他拿起話筒撥了號碼。

examples.en: The receiver of the package must sign for it.
examples.zh: 包裹的收件人必須簽收。

examples.en: The wind is blowing from the northwest today.
examples.zh: 今天的風從西北方吹來。

examples.en: They drove northwest for several hours before stopping.
examples.zh: 他們向西北開了幾小時的車才停下來。

examples.en: A quiet neighborhood is highly desirable for families with children.
examples.zh: 安靜的社區對有小孩的家庭來說非常理想。

examples.en: It is desirable to book your flight early during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 假期期間最好提早預訂航班。

examples.en: The company owns a fleet of delivery trucks.
examples.zh: 該公司擁有一支送貨卡車車隊。

examples.en: A fleet of fishing boats returned to the harbor at dawn.
examples.zh: 一支漁船隊在黎明時返回港口。

examples.en: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水是氫和氧的化合物。

examples.en: The children played safely inside the walled compound.
examples.zh: 孩子們在圍牆內的院子裡安全地玩耍。

examples.en: Police conducted a raid on the suspected drug house.
examples.zh: 警方突襲了那間疑似毒品交易場所。

examples.en: The enemy planned a raid on the supply depot.
examples.zh: 敵軍計劃突襲補給站。

examples.en: She held the presidency of the club for two terms.
examples.zh: 她擔任該社團的會長職務兩個任期。

examples.en: His presidency was marked by economic reforms.
examples.zh: 他的總統任期以經濟改革為標誌。

examples.en: There was a subtle change in her tone of voice.
examples.zh: 她的語氣有微妙的變化。

examples.en: The dish has a subtle flavor of garlic and herbs.
examples.zh: 這道菜有大蒜和香草的淡淡風味。

examples.en: He used a hand pump to inflate the bicycle tire.
examples.zh: 他用打氣筒將腳踏車輪胎打氣。

examples.en: The heart pumps blood throughout the body.
examples.zh: 心臟將血液泵送至全身。

examples.en: Sheffield is known for its steel industry.
examples.zh: 謝菲爾德以其鋼鐵工業聞名。

examples.en: They took a train to Sheffield to visit relatives.
examples.zh: 他們搭火車去謝菲爾德探親。

examples.en: They rented a villa by the sea for the summer.
examples.zh: 他們在海邊租了一棟別墅避暑。

examples.en: The luxurious villa has a private pool and garden.
examples.zh: 這棟豪華別墅有私人泳池和花園。

examples.en: He is a man of great integrity who always keeps his word.
examples.zh: 他是個非常正直的人，總是遵守承諾。

examples.en: The earthquake threatened the integrity of the building.
examples.zh: 地震威脅到這棟建築的完整性。

examples.en: The case was brought before an international tribunal.
examples.zh: 此案被提交至國際法庭審理。

examples.en: The tribunal ruled that the dismissal was unfair.
examples.zh: 法庭裁定該解僱不公平。

examples.en: There is a strong correlation between smoking and lung cancer.
examples.zh: 吸菸與肺癌之間有很強的相關性。

examples.en: Researchers found no correlation between the two variables.
examples.zh: 研究人員發現這兩個變數之間沒有關聯。

examples.en: She was reluctant to lend her car to a stranger.
examples.zh: 她不願意把車借給陌生人。

examples.en: He gave a reluctant nod of agreement.
examples.zh: 他勉強點頭同意。

examples.en: She desperately needed a doctor for her sick child.
examples.zh: 她極度需要醫生來救治生病的孩子。

examples.en: He searched desperately for his lost passport.
examples.zh: 他拼命尋找遺失的護照。

examples.en: The small harbour was filled with fishing boats early in the morning.
examples.zh: 清晨時分，小港口停滿了漁船。

examples.en: She could no longer harbour resentment against her old friend.
examples.zh: 她再也無法對老朋友心懷怨恨了。

examples.en: The warmth of the fireplace made the room feel cozy.
examples.zh: 壁爐的溫暖讓房間感覺很舒適。

examples.en: He greeted us with such warmth that we felt like old friends.
examples.zh: 他如此熱情地歡迎我們，讓我們感覺像老朋友一樣。

examples.en: The legislative process can take months before a bill becomes law.
examples.zh: 立法過程可能需要數月，法案才能成為法律。

examples.en: Members of the legislative body debated the new tax proposal.
examples.zh: 立法機構的成員們辯論了新的稅收提案。

examples.en: The proposition that all men are created equal is fundamental to democracy.
examples.zh: 人人生而平等的主張是民主的基礎。

examples.en: She rejected his proposition to start a business together.
examples.zh: 她拒絕了他一起創業的提議。

examples.en: He was arrested for credit card fraud and could face prison time.
examples.zh: 他因信用卡詐騙被捕，可能面臨牢獄之災。

examples.en: The so-called doctor turned out to be a fraud who had no medical license.
examples.zh: 那位所謂的醫生結果是個沒有醫療執照的騙子。

examples.en: His rude comments provoked an angry response from the audience.
examples.zh: 他無禮的評論激起了觀眾的憤怒回應。

examples.en: The new policy could provoke widespread protests across the country.
examples.zh: 新政策可能在全國引發大規模抗議。

examples.en: Her eighteenth birthday party was held at a rooftop restaurant.
examples.zh: 她的十八歲生日派對在一家屋頂餐廳舉行。

examples.en: The eighteenth chapter of the book reveals the killer's identity.
examples.zh: 這本書的第十八章揭露了兇手的身份。

examples.en: The colonel ordered his troops to retreat to the base.
examples.zh: 上校命令他的部隊撤回基地。

examples.en: After twenty years of service, he was promoted to colonel.
examples.zh: 服役二十年後，他被晉升為上校。

examples.en: The team won the championship with an overwhelming victory.
examples.zh: 該隊以壓倒性的勝利贏得了冠軍。

examples.en: She felt an overwhelming sense of relief when the exam was over.
examples.zh: 考試結束時，她感到一種難以抵抗的如釋重負感。

examples.en: This herb is often used in traditional medicine to treat colds.
examples.zh: 這種藥草常用於傳統醫學中治療感冒。

examples.en: Add some fresh herbs to the soup for extra flavor.
examples.zh: 在湯裡加一些新鮮香草以增添風味。

examples.en: The concert will take place in the city's new sports arena.
examples.zh: 音樂會將在城市的新體育館舉行。

examples.en: She has always been comfortable in the political arena.
examples.zh: 她在政治舞台上總是游刃有餘。

examples.en: He has consistently outperformed his colleagues in sales.
examples.zh: 他在銷售方面一直表現得比同事出色。

examples.en: The team practiced consistently and improved throughout the season.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍持續練習，並在整個賽季中不斷進步。

examples.en: The House of Lords debated the new immigration bill for hours.
examples.zh: 上議院對新的移民法案辯論了數小時。

examples.en: Many lords in the medieval era owned vast estates.
examples.zh: 中世紀的許多領主擁有廣闊的莊園。

examples.en: The video game is praised for its stunning graphics and smooth animation.
examples.zh: 這款電子遊戲因其驚人的圖形而受到讚譽。

examples.en: She works as a designer, creating graphics for websites and apps.
examples.zh: 她是一名設計師，為網站和應用程式製作圖形。

examples.en: The government plans to invest heavily in transportation infrastructure.
examples.zh: 政府計劃大力投資交通基礎設施。

examples.en: A country's economic growth depends on solid infrastructure.
examples.zh: 一個國家的經濟增長取決於穩固的基礎設施。

examples.en: They enjoy outdoor activities like hiking and camping.
examples.zh: 他們喜歡徒步旅行和露營等戶外活動。

examples.en: The outdoor pool is open only during the summer months.
examples.zh: 戶外游泳池僅在夏季開放。

examples.en: The artist used brightly coloured paints to create a vibrant mural.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家使用鮮豔的顏料創作出充滿活力的壁畫。

examples.en: The report was clearly coloured by the author's personal bias.
examples.zh: 這份報告明顯受到作者個人偏見的渲染。

examples.en: The accident left him with a permanent injury to his left limb.
examples.zh: 那場事故使他的左肢永久受傷。

examples.en: The tree's limbs were heavy with ripe fruit.
examples.zh: 樹枝上掛滿了成熟的果實。

examples.en: The fireworks display was truly spectacular, lighting up the entire sky.
examples.zh: 煙火表演真是壯觀，照亮了整個天空。

examples.en: She made a spectacular comeback after being behind by ten points.
examples.zh: 她在落後十分的情況下上演了驚人的逆轉。

examples.en: There is widespread speculation that the company will merge with its rival.
examples.zh: 人們普遍猜測該公司將與競爭對手合併。

examples.en: He lost a lot of money through speculation in the stock market.
examples.zh: 他因在股市投機而損失了很多錢。

examples.en: The transmission of the disease can be prevented by washing your hands.
examples.zh: 勤洗手可以預防這種疾病的傳播。

examples.en: The car's transmission needs to be repaired.
examples.zh: 這輛車的變速器需要修理。

examples.en: The separation of the two countries was marked by a river.
examples.zh: 這兩國的分界是一條河流。

examples.en: After years of marriage, they decided on a separation.
examples.zh: 結婚多年後，他們決定分居。

examples.en: The virtual reality game allows players to explore a digital world.
examples.zh: 這款虛擬實境遊戲讓玩家探索數位世界。

examples.en: The team's virtual victory was almost certain.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍的實質勝利幾乎是肯定的。

examples.en: The judge has the discretion to reduce the sentence.
examples.zh: 法官有斟酌減刑的權力。

examples.en: Please use discretion when discussing this matter.
examples.zh: 討論此事時請謹慎。

examples.en: I looked up the phone number in the directory.
examples.zh: 我在電話簿裡查了那個電話號碼。

examples.en: The computer program creates a new directory for each project.
examples.zh: 這個電腦程式會為每個專案建立一個新目錄。

examples.en: The storm is moving toward the southeast.
examples.zh: 暴風雨正朝著東南方移動。

examples.en: They live in the southeast part of the city.
examples.zh: 他們住在城市的東南區。

examples.en: The dean of the college announced a new policy.
examples.zh: 學院院長宣布了一項新政策。

examples.en: She was appointed dean of the law school last year.
examples.zh: 她去年被任命為法學院院長。

examples.en: The defender blocked the opponent's shot.
examples.zh: 防守者擋住了對手的射門。

examples.en: He is a strong defender of human rights.
examples.zh: 他是人權的堅定捍衛者。

examples.en: The team won three successive games.
examples.zh: 這支球隊連續贏了三場比賽。

examples.en: Successive governments have failed to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 歷屆政府都未能解決這個問題。

examples.en: I felt a tingling sensation in my fingers.
examples.zh: 我的手指有刺痛的感覺。

examples.en: The movie caused a sensation among young audiences.
examples.zh: 這部電影在年輕觀眾中引起了轟動。

examples.en: The official was arrested for corruption.
examples.zh: 這名官員因貪汙被捕。

examples.en: Corruption can ruin a company's reputation.
examples.zh: 腐敗會毀掉一家公司的聲譽。

examples.en: The astronomer discovered a new planet.
examples.zh: 這位天文學家發現了一顆新行星。

examples.en: Astronomers use telescopes to study the stars.
examples.zh: 天文學家使用望遠鏡研究星星。

examples.en: The contractor will start building the house next week.
examples.zh: 承包商下週將開始建造這棟房子。

examples.en: We hired a contractor to remodel the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們雇了一名承包商來改造廚房。

examples.en: The density of water is higher than that of ice.
examples.zh: 水的密度比冰高。

examples.en: The city has a high population density.
examples.zh: 這座城市的人口密度很高。

examples.en: The availability of fresh fruit varies by season.
examples.zh: 新鮮水果的供應情況因季節而異。

examples.en: Please check the availability of the hotel rooms.
examples.zh: 請查詢飯店房間的空房情況。

examples.en: The installation of the new software took an hour.
examples.zh: 新軟體的安裝花了一小時。

examples.en: The art installation attracted many visitors.
examples.zh: 這件藝術裝置吸引了許多參觀者。

examples.en: The online forum is a place for discussing various topics.
examples.zh: 這個線上論壇是討論各種話題的地方。

examples.en: They attended a forum on environmental protection.
examples.zh: 他們參加了一場關於環境保護的討論會。

examples.en: Capitalism encourages private ownership and free markets.
examples.zh: 資本主義鼓勵私有制和自由市場。

examples.en: The book compares capitalism and socialism.
examples.zh: 這本書比較了資本主義和社會主義。

examples.en: You can bring your spouse to the company dinner.
examples.zh: 你可以帶配偶參加公司晚宴。

examples.en: She listed her spouse as her emergency contact.
examples.zh: 她將配偶列為緊急聯絡人。

examples.en: Sodium is an essential element in table salt.
examples.zh: 鈉是食鹽中的必需元素。

examples.en: Too much sodium in your diet can raise blood pressure.
examples.zh: 飲食中鈉含量過高會導致血壓升高。

examples.en: The tropical rainforest is home to countless species of plants and animals.
examples.zh: 熱帶雨林是無數動植物的家。

examples.en: We enjoyed the tropical weather during our vacation in Hawaii.
examples.zh: 我們在夏威夷度假時享受了熱帶天氣。

examples.en: The liberation of the prisoners was a moment of great joy.
examples.zh: 囚犯的釋放是一個極度歡樂的時刻。

examples.en: She fought for the liberation of women from traditional roles.
examples.zh: 她為女性從傳統角色中解放而奮鬥。

examples.en: The reporting on the election was biased and inaccurate.
examples.zh: 關於選舉的報導有偏見且不準確。

examples.en: Good reporting requires thorough research and fact-checking.
examples.zh: 良好的報導需要徹底的研究和事實查核。

examples.en: The exploration of the deep sea has revealed many unknown creatures.
examples.zh: 深海的探險揭示了許多未知的生物。

examples.en: Space exploration has led to many technological advances.
examples.zh: 太空探測帶來了許多技術進步。

examples.en: She carried the tray of drinks carefully to the table.
examples.zh: 她小心地將飲料托盤端到桌上。

examples.en: Please put your dirty dishes on the tray by the sink.
examples.zh: 請將髒盤子放在水槽旁的托盤上。

examples.en: The teacher gave us feedback on our essays.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們關於論文的回饋。

examples.en: We need more feedback from customers to improve our service.
examples.zh: 我們需要更多顧客的回應來改善服務。

examples.en: The government provides a subsidy for renewable energy projects.
examples.zh: 政府為再生能源項目提供補助金。

examples.en: Without the subsidy, many farmers would struggle to survive.
examples.zh: 沒有補貼，許多農民將難以生存。

examples.en: She has been seeing a therapist to help with her anxiety.
examples.zh: 她一直在看治療師來幫助她應對焦慮。

examples.en: The physical therapist taught him exercises to strengthen his back.
examples.zh: 物理治療師教他一些運動來強化背部。

examples.en: The recipient of the award gave a heartfelt speech.
examples.zh: 獲獎者發表了由衷的演講。

examples.en: Please ensure the recipient's address is correct before sending the package.
examples.zh: 寄送包裹前請確認收件人的地址正確。

examples.en: The fierce dog barked loudly at the strangers.
examples.zh: 那隻兇猛的狗對陌生人狂吠。

examples.en: Competition for the job was fierce, with over 200 applicants.
examples.zh: 這份工作的競爭很激烈，有超過200名申請者。

examples.en: The documentary about ancient civilizations was absolutely fascinating.
examples.zh: 關於古代文明的紀錄片絕對迷人。

examples.en: I find the study of languages fascinating.
examples.zh: 我覺得語言研究很吸引人。

examples.en: Her sensitivity to criticism made it hard for her to accept feedback.
examples.zh: 她對批評的敏感使她難以接受回饋。

examples.en: The device has high sensitivity and can detect very small changes.
examples.zh: 該設備具有高靈敏度，可以檢測到非常小的變化。

examples.en: The magnitude of the earthquake was 7.0 on the Richter scale.
examples.zh: 地震的規模是芮氏規模7.0。

examples.en: Few people understood the magnitude of the problem.
examples.zh: 很少有人理解問題的嚴重性。

examples.en: The child clung to her mother's hand in the crowded market.
examples.zh: 孩子在擁擠的市場中緊緊抓住母親的手。

examples.en: Some people cling to old habits even when they are harmful.
examples.zh: 有些人即使舊習慣有害也堅持不放。

examples.en: This room is exclusively for staff members.
examples.zh: 這個房間僅供員工使用。

examples.en: The interview was conducted exclusively in English.
examples.zh: 採訪完全以英語進行。

examples.en: She decided to enroll in a photography class this summer.
examples.zh: 她決定今年夏天報名參加攝影課。

examples.en: To enroll, please fill out this form and pay the fee.
examples.zh: 要註冊，請填寫此表格並支付費用。

examples.en: Education is compulsory for children between the ages of 6 and 15.
examples.zh: 6至15歲的兒童必須接受義務教育。

examples.en: The company made safety training compulsory for all employees.
examples.zh: 公司強制所有員工參加安全培訓。

examples.en: The family gathering on Thanksgiving was a joyful occasion.
examples.zh: 感恩節的家庭聚會是一個歡樂的場合。

examples.en: There was a large gathering of people in the square to protest.
examples.zh: 廣場上有一大群人聚集抗議。

examples.en: We hiked along the ridge of the mountain, enjoying the view.
examples.zh: 我們沿著山脊健行，欣賞風景。

examples.en: The roof has a central ridge that runs from front to back.
examples.zh: 屋頂有一個從前到後的中央脊線。

examples.en: The liver plays a vital role in detoxifying the body.
examples.zh: 肝臟在身體排毒中扮演重要角色。

examples.en: He ordered liver and onions at the diner.
examples.zh: 他在餐廳點了肝臟和洋蔥。

examples.en: The city was in chaos after the riot broke out downtown.
examples.zh: 暴動在市中心爆發後，城市陷入混亂。

examples.en: Police were called to control the riot at the stadium.
examples.zh: 警方被叫來控制體育場的暴動。

examples.en: The restaurant sources its ingredients locally to support farmers.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳在當地採購食材以支持農民。

examples.en: This medicine can be applied locally to reduce swelling.
examples.zh: 這種藥可以局部塗抹以減輕腫脹。

examples.en: She conceived the idea for the app while waiting for a bus.
examples.zh: 她在等公車時構思出這個應用程式的想法。

examples.en: The couple tried for years to conceive a child.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻努力多年想要懷孕。

examples.en: The hotel caters to business travelers with free Wi-Fi and meeting rooms.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供免費 Wi-Fi 和會議室，以迎合商務旅客的需求。

examples.en: They hired a company to cater the wedding reception.
examples.zh: 他們聘請了一家公司在婚宴上提供餐飲服務。

examples.en: A free shuttle runs between the airport and the hotel.
examples.zh: 機場和飯店之間有免費接駁車往返。

examples.en: She shuttles between Taipei and Hsinchu for work every day.
examples.zh: 她每天往返台北和新竹工作。

examples.en: The minister met with her counterpart from Japan to discuss trade.
examples.zh: 部長與日本對口官員會面討論貿易。

examples.en: This old building has a modern counterpart across the street.
examples.zh: 這棟老建築在對街有一棟現代化的相應建築。

examples.en: The teacher instructed the students to read the chapter before class.
examples.zh: 老師指示學生課前閱讀這一章。

examples.en: He was instructed to report to the office immediately.
examples.zh: 他接到指示要立即到辦公室報到。

examples.en: She took an intensive course to improve her English in three months.
examples.zh: 她參加了密集課程，在三個月內提升英語能力。

examples.en: Intensive farming can increase crop yields but may harm the soil.
examples.zh: 集約農業可以提高作物產量，但可能損害土壤。

examples.en: The trader bought goods in bulk and sold them at the market.
examples.zh: 商人在市場上大量購買商品並轉售。

examples.en: As a stock trader, he watches the market closely every day.
examples.zh: 作為股票交易員，他每天密切關注市場。

examples.en: The doctor decided to isolate the patient to prevent the infection from spreading.
examples.zh: 醫生決定隔離病人以防止感染擴散。

examples.en: Scientists managed to isolate the virus in the lab.
examples.zh: 科學家成功在實驗室中分離出該病毒。

examples.en: Rice and bread are rich in carbohydrates and provide energy.
examples.zh: 米飯和麵包富含碳水化合物，能提供能量。

examples.en: Athletes often load up on carbohydrates before a big race.
examples.zh: 運動員常在大比賽前補充碳水化合物。

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed her with a mild flu and told her to rest.
examples.zh: 醫生診斷她得了輕微流感，並囑咐她休息。

examples.en: Engineers are trying to diagnose the problem with the machine.
examples.zh: 工程師正試圖診斷機器的問題所在。

examples.en: She works as a private tutor to help students with math.
examples.zh: 她擔任私人家教，幫助學生學習數學。

examples.en: He tutored his younger brother in English every weekend.
examples.zh: 他每個週末指導弟弟學英語。

examples.en: We stayed at a cozy inn by the lake during our vacation.
examples.zh: 我們度假時住在湖邊一家舒適的旅館。

examples.en: The old inn has been welcoming travelers for over a century.
examples.zh: 這家老客棧一個多世紀以來一直歡迎旅客。

examples.en: The teacher drew a diagram to explain how the water cycle works.
examples.zh: 老師畫了一張圖解來解釋水循環如何運作。

examples.en: Please refer to the diagram on page 10 for the assembly steps.
examples.zh: 請參考第 10 頁的圖表以了解組裝步驟。

examples.en: The children rode their bikes on the pavement outside the house.
examples.zh: 孩子們在屋外的人行道上騎腳踏車。

examples.en: After the rain, the pavement was slippery and shiny.
examples.zh: 雨後，路面又滑又亮。

examples.en: He finally conceded that he had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 他終於承認自己犯了錯。

examples.en: The company refused to concede to the workers' demands.
examples.zh: 公司拒絕在工人的要求上讓步。

examples.en: Queen Elizabeth II's reign lasted for over seventy years.
examples.zh: 伊莉莎白二世的統治持續了七十多年。

examples.en: The king reigned wisely and was loved by his people.
examples.zh: 這位國王明智地統治，深受人民愛戴。

examples.en: The two groups clashed over the use of the public space.
examples.zh: 這兩個團體為了公共空間的使用發生衝突。

examples.en: There was a loud clash of cymbals at the end of the performance.
examples.zh: 表演結束時響起響亮的鈸撞擊聲。

examples.en: The police car sped down the highway in pursuit of the stolen vehicle.
examples.zh: 警車在高速公路上疾馳，追捕被盜車輛。

examples.en: She enjoys painting as a leisurely pursuit on weekends.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在週末把繪畫當作休閒娛樂。

examples.en: The company has a progressive policy on parental leave.
examples.zh: 這家公司對育嬰假採取進步的政策。

examples.en: Some countries use a progressive tax system to reduce inequality.
examples.zh: 有些國家採用累進稅制來減少不平等。

examples.en: We waited at the bus terminal for over an hour.
examples.zh: 我們在公車終點站等了一個多小時。

examples.en: The doctor said the disease was terminal and offered palliative care.
examples.zh: 醫生說這種疾病已是末期，並提供安寧療護。

examples.en: The two teams cooperated closely to finish the project on time.
examples.zh: 兩個團隊密切合作，準時完成專案。

examples.en: If you don't cooperate with the investigation, you may face charges.
examples.zh: 如果你不配合調查，可能會面臨指控。

examples.en: Early humans used primitive tools made of stone and wood.
examples.zh: 早期人類使用石頭和木頭製成的原始工具。

examples.en: The software is still in a primitive stage and lacks many features.
examples.zh: 這套軟體仍處於原始階段，缺少許多功能。

examples.en: Please seal the envelope before you mail it.
examples.zh: 寄出前請把信封封好。

examples.en: The document bore the official seal of the university.
examples.zh: 這份文件蓋有大學的官方印章。

examples.en: She suffered an occupational injury after years of lifting heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 她因多年搬運重箱而受了職業傷害。

examples.en: The clinic offers occupational therapy for patients recovering from strokes.
examples.zh: 這家診所為中風復健的病人提供職能治療。

examples.en: They reached a verbal agreement but never signed a contract.
examples.zh: 他們達成口頭協議，但從未簽約。

examples.en: Her verbal skills impressed the interviewers.
examples.zh: 她的口語表達能力讓面試官印象深刻。

examples.en: The coastal town attracts many tourists in summer.
examples.zh: 這座沿海城鎮在夏天吸引許多遊客。

examples.en: Rising sea levels threaten coastal communities around the world.
examples.zh: 海平面上升威脅世界各地的沿海社區。

examples.en: Public sentiment turned against the new policy after the protests.
examples.zh: 抗議過後，公眾情緒轉為反對這項新政策。

examples.en: He expressed his sentiments about the war in a heartfelt letter.
examples.zh: 他在一封真摯的信中表達了對戰爭的看法。

examples.en: The two parties have deep ideological differences on economic policy.
examples.zh: 兩黨在經濟政策上有深刻的意識形態分歧。

examples.en: The book offers an ideological critique of modern consumer culture.
examples.zh: 這本書對現代消費文化提出意識形態的批判。

examples.en: The market eventually reached an equilibrium where supply equaled demand.
examples.zh: 市場最終達到供需相等的均衡狀態。

examples.en: She lost her equilibrium and fell off the balance beam.
examples.zh: 她失去平衡，從平衡木上摔了下來。

examples.en: The students learned how to multiply a matrix by a vector.
examples.zh: 學生學會如何將矩陣與向量相乘。

examples.en: The fossils were embedded in a matrix of fine-grained rock.
examples.zh: 化石嵌在細粒岩石的基質中。

examples.en: The knight set out on a quest to find the lost treasure.
examples.zh: 騎士踏上尋找失落寶藏的旅程。

examples.en: Scientists continue their quest for a cure for cancer.
examples.zh: 科學家持續尋找癌症的療法。

examples.en: The striker scored the winning goal in the final minute.
examples.zh: 前鋒在最後一分鐘踢進致勝球。

examples.en: The strikers demanded higher wages and better working conditions.
examples.zh: 罷工者要求提高工資和改善工作條件。

examples.en: She hired a real estate broker to help her find a house.
examples.zh: 她請了一位房地產經紀人幫她找房子。

examples.en: The two companies asked a lawyer to broker a deal.
examples.zh: 兩家公司請律師斡旋達成一筆交易。

examples.en: You can speak freely; nothing you say will leave this room.
examples.zh: 你可以暢所欲言；你說的話不會傳出這個房間。

examples.en: The museum offers freely accessible online resources for students.
examples.zh: 博物館為學生提供可免費使用的線上資源。

examples.en: The balloon floated upwards until it disappeared from sight.
examples.zh: 氣球向上飄，直到消失在視線之外。

examples.en: Prices have been trending upwards since the beginning of the year.
examples.zh: 自年初以來，物價一直呈上升趨勢。

examples.en: My grandfather manages his diabetes with diet and exercise.
examples.zh: 我爺爺透過飲食和運動控制糖尿病。

examples.en: Untreated diabetes can lead to serious complications.
examples.zh: 未治療的糖尿病可能導致嚴重的併發症。

examples.en: She was overcome with grief after her mother passed away.
examples.zh: 母親過世後，她悲痛欲絕。

examples.en: The community shared their grief over the loss of the beloved teacher.
examples.zh: 社區居民共同分擔失去這位敬愛老師的悲傷。

examples.en: The breakdown of negotiations led to a prolonged strike.
examples.zh: 談判破裂導致了長時間的罷工。

examples.en: He suffered a mental breakdown after months of overwork.
examples.zh: 他因數月過度工作而精神崩潰。

examples.en: The inmate has been in prison for over ten years.
examples.zh: 這名囚犯已經在監獄裡超過十年了。

examples.en: She volunteers at the hospital, reading to elderly inmates.
examples.zh: 她在醫院當志工，讀書給年長的住院病人聽。

examples.en: Please dispose of your trash in the proper bins.
examples.zh: 請將垃圾丟棄在正確的垃圾桶裡。

examples.en: He disposed of his old car and bought a new one.
examples.zh: 他處理掉舊車，買了一輛新的。

examples.en: Children love to blow bubbles in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在公園裡吹泡泡。

examples.en: The water began to bubble as it reached a boil.
examples.zh: 水沸騰時開始冒泡。

examples.en: The small village is isolated from the rest of the country.
examples.zh: 這個小村莊與國內其他地方隔絕。

examples.en: After the argument, she felt isolated from her friends.
examples.zh: 爭吵之後，她覺得被朋友孤立了。

examples.en: This restaurant specializes in authentic Italian cuisine.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳專攻道地的義大利料理。

examples.en: She decided to specialize in pediatrics after medical school.
examples.zh: 醫學院畢業後，她決定專攻小兒科。

examples.en: He tucked the receipt into his wallet.
examples.zh: 他把收據塞進錢包裡。

examples.en: The mother tucked her child into bed and read a story.
examples.zh: 母親把孩子裹進被窩裡，然後讀故事給他聽。

examples.en: She faced a dilemma: accept the job offer or stay with her family.
examples.zh: 她面臨兩難：接受工作機會還是留在家鄉。

examples.en: The committee is in a dilemma over which proposal to approve.
examples.zh: 委員會對於該批准哪個提案陷入兩難。

examples.en: The gardener trimmed the hedge into a neat rectangle.
examples.zh: 園丁把樹籬修剪成整齊的長方形。

examples.en: When asked about his plans, he hedged and changed the subject.
examples.zh: 被問到他的計畫時，他閃爍其詞並轉移話題。

examples.en: The explorers set foot on virgin territory.
examples.zh: 探險家們踏上未開發的處女地。

examples.en: She ordered a virgin cocktail since she doesn't drink alcohol.
examples.zh: 她點了一杯無酒精雞尾酒，因為她不喝酒。

examples.en: The audience gave the speaker a hostile reception.
examples.zh: 聽眾對講者報以敵意的反應。

examples.en: They encountered hostile forces near the border.
examples.zh: 他們在邊境附近遭遇敵軍。

examples.en: She hung her coat on the rack by the door.
examples.zh: 她把外套掛在門邊的架子上。

examples.en: Guilt racked his mind for days after the incident.
examples.zh: 事件發生後，罪惡感折磨了他的心靈好幾天。

examples.en: The dove is symbolic of peace.
examples.zh: 鴿子是和平的象徵。

examples.en: The couple exchanged symbolic gifts at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 這對情侶在儀式上交換了象徵性的禮物。

examples.en: The jury returned a verdict of not guilty.
examples.zh: 陪審團作出無罪的裁決。

examples.en: What's your verdict on the new restaurant?
examples.zh: 你對這家新餐廳的評價如何？

examples.en: The project was deemed too risky to continue.
examples.zh: 這個計畫被認為風險太高而無法繼續。

examples.en: She deems it necessary to double-check the figures.
examples.zh: 她認為有必要再次核對這些數字。

examples.en: The deadline for submission of entries is Friday.
examples.zh: 參賽作品的提交截止日期是星期五。

examples.en: His submission to the authority was unexpected.
examples.zh: 他對權威的服從令人意外。

examples.en: The new manager introduced several changes from her predecessor.
examples.zh: 新經理推行了幾項與前任不同的變革。

examples.en: This smartphone is much faster than its predecessor.
examples.zh: 這款智慧型手機比前一代快得多。

examples.en: The provincial government announced new road construction plans.
examples.zh: 省政府宣布了新的道路建設計畫。

examples.en: His provincial attitude made it hard for him to accept new ideas.
examples.zh: 他偏狹的態度讓他難以接受新觀念。

examples.en: The disease was hitherto unknown to medical science.
examples.zh: 這種疾病迄今醫學界仍未知。

examples.en: Hitherto, she had never traveled outside her country.
examples.zh: 至今為止，她從未離開過自己的國家。

examples.en: Building the bridge was a massive undertaking.
examples.zh: 建造這座橋是一項浩大的工程。

examples.en: He gave an undertaking that the work would be finished on time.
examples.zh: 他保證這項工作會按時完成。

examples.en: The coffin was carried by six pallbearers.
examples.zh: 棺材由六名抬棺者抬著。

examples.en: They coffined the remains and prepared for the funeral.
examples.zh: 他們將遺體裝進棺材，並準備葬禮。

examples.en: The scientist made a notable contribution to modern medicine.
examples.zh: 這位科學家對現代醫學做出了顯著的貢獻。

examples.en: Several notable guests attended the charity dinner last night.
examples.zh: 幾位知名人士出席了昨晚的慈善晚宴。

examples.en: He straightened his collar before entering the meeting room.
examples.zh: 他進會議室前整理了一下衣領。

examples.en: The police officer collared the suspect as he tried to flee.
examples.zh: 嫌犯試圖逃跑時，警察抓住了他。

examples.en: The farmer kept a large bull in the field behind the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫在穀倉後面的田裡養了一頭大公牛。

examples.en: He is as strong as a bull and can lift heavy equipment easily.
examples.zh: 他壯得像頭牛，能輕鬆舉起沉重的設備。

examples.en: We stayed in a small wooden hut near the lake during the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行期間我們住在湖邊的一間小木屋裡。

examples.en: The soldiers built a temporary hut to shelter from the rain.
examples.zh: 士兵們搭建了一個臨時小屋來避雨。

examples.en: She injured her thigh while playing basketball yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天打籃球時傷到了大腿。

examples.en: The chef removed the thigh from the roasted chicken and served it.
examples.zh: 廚師將烤雞的腿肉取下並端上桌。

examples.en: They shared an intimate dinner at a quiet restaurant.
examples.zh: 他們在一家安靜的餐廳共進了一頓親密的晚餐。

examples.en: She intimated that she might be looking for a new job.
examples.zh: 她暗示自己可能在找新工作。

examples.en: The police uncovered a conspiracy to steal the company's data.
examples.zh: 警方揭露了一起竊取公司資料的陰謀。

examples.en: He was accused of being part of a conspiracy against the government.
examples.zh: 他被指控參與了一個反政府的陰謀集團。

examples.en: Thousands of fans attended the rally to support their team.
examples.zh: 數千名球迷參加了支持球隊的集會。

examples.en: The team managed to rally in the final quarter and win the game.
examples.zh: 該隊在最後一節重整旗鼓，贏得了比賽。

examples.en: This lightweight chair is made of aluminum and can be folded easily.
examples.zh: 這把輕便的椅子是鋁製的，可以輕鬆折疊。

examples.en: Aluminum is widely used in the production of beverage cans.
examples.zh: 鋁被廣泛用於飲料罐的生產。

examples.en: An atom consists of a nucleus and orbiting electrons.
examples.zh: 原子由原子核和繞其運行的電子組成。

examples.en: There isn't an atom of truth in his story.
examples.zh: 他的故事裡沒有一絲一毫的真實性。

examples.en: The doctor put a few stitches in the cut on his hand.
examples.zh: 醫生在他手上的傷口縫了幾針。

examples.en: She learned to stitch a hem neatly by hand.
examples.zh: 她學會了用手工整地縫合褶邊。

examples.en: He tried to manipulate the stock price by spreading false rumors.
examples.zh: 他試圖透過散佈假謠言來操縱股價。

examples.en: The robot can manipulate small objects with great precision.
examples.zh: 這個機器人能非常精確地操作小物件。

examples.en: The singer made her debut at a small club last night.
examples.zh: 這位歌手昨晚在一家小俱樂部初次登臺。

examples.en: The company will debut its new electric car at the auto show.
examples.zh: 該公司將在車展上首次公開其新款電動車。

examples.en: The tragic accident claimed the lives of three people.
examples.zh: 這起悲慘的意外奪走了三條人命。

examples.en: She played the tragic heroine in the school play.
examples.zh: 她在學校話劇中飾演悲劇女主角。

examples.en: We should utilize solar energy to reduce electricity costs.
examples.zh: 我們應該利用太陽能來降低電費。

examples.en: The teacher utilized games to make the lesson more engaging.
examples.zh: 老師利用遊戲讓課程更有趣。

examples.en: Her parents gave her lots of encouragement to pursue her dream.
examples.zh: 她的父母給了她許多鼓勵去追求夢想。

examples.en: A few words of encouragement can make a big difference.
examples.zh: 幾句鼓勵的話就能帶來很大的改變。

examples.en: I can say with certainty that the meeting will be postponed.
examples.zh: 我可以肯定地說會議將延期。

examples.en: Death is the only certainty in life.
examples.zh: 死亡是人生中唯一確定的事。

examples.en: The repair of the old car turned out to be very costly.
examples.zh: 這輛舊車的維修費用非常昂貴。

examples.en: Choosing the wrong supplier was a costly mistake for the company.
examples.zh: 選錯供應商對公司來說是一個代價高昂的錯誤。

examples.en: The news of the accident caused her great distress.
examples.zh: 事故的消息讓她非常苦惱。

examples.en: He was distressed to find that his wallet had been stolen.
examples.zh: 發現錢包被偷時，他感到非常痛苦。

examples.en: She rightly pointed out that the plan had several flaws.
examples.zh: 她正確地指出這個計畫有幾個缺陷。

examples.en: The public rightly expected the government to take action.
examples.zh: 民眾理所當然地期望政府採取行動。

examples.en: We spent a fortnight traveling around the island last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我們花了兩星期環島旅行。

examples.en: The report must be submitted within a fortnight of the meeting.
examples.zh: 報告必須在會議結束後兩星期內提交。

examples.en: Regular exercise improves blood circulation and overall health.
examples.zh: 規律運動能改善血液循環和整體健康。

examples.en: The magazine's circulation has doubled since the new editor took over.
examples.zh: 自從新編輯接手後，這本雜誌的發行量已經翻倍。

examples.en: She recovered remarkably quickly after the surgery.
examples.zh: 手術後她恢復得異常迅速。

examples.en: Remarkably, no one was injured in the accident.
examples.zh: 引人注目的是，事故中沒有人受傷。

examples.en: The soldiers stood erect during the national anthem.
examples.zh: 國歌演奏時，士兵們筆直站立。

examples.en: They plan to erect a monument in the town square.
examples.zh: 他們計劃在城鎮廣場上樹立一座紀念碑。

examples.en: Please enclose a copy of your ID with the application.
examples.zh: 請在申請表中附上一份身分證影本。

examples.en: A high fence encloses the entire property.
examples.zh: 一道高籬笆圍住了整個房地產。

examples.en: The children scrambled up the rocky hill to get a better view.
examples.zh: 孩子們爬上岩石山丘以獲得更好的視野。

examples.en: When the sale started, shoppers scrambled for the best deals.
examples.zh: 特賣開始時，購物者爭相搶購最划算的商品。

examples.en: A short speech will precede the award ceremony.
examples.zh: 頒獎典禮前會有一段簡短的演講。

examples.en: The storm was preceded by a strange calm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨來臨前有一種奇怪的平靜。

examples.en: The irony is that the fire station burned down.
examples.zh: 諷刺的是，消防站被燒毀了。

examples.en: She used irony to criticize the policy without being direct.
examples.zh: 她運用反語來批評政策，而不直接明說。

examples.en: I called to enquire about the train schedule.
examples.zh: 我打電話詢問火車時刻表。

examples.en: She enquired whether the room was still available.
examples.zh: 她詢問那個房間是否還空著。

examples.en: Children learn social skills by interacting with their peers.
examples.zh: 孩子們透過與同儕互動來學習社交技巧。

examples.en: The two chemicals interact to produce a bright light.
examples.zh: 這兩種化學物質相互作用產生亮光。

examples.en: He showed great restraint by not responding to the insult.
examples.zh: 他表現出極大的克制，沒有回應侮辱。

examples.en: The government imposed restraints on imports to protect local industries.
examples.zh: 政府對進口施加限制以保護本地產業。

examples.en: There is a clear contradiction between his words and his actions.
examples.zh: 他的言辭和行動之間有明顯的矛盾。

examples.en: The witness's statement was full of contradictions.
examples.zh: 證人的陳述充滿矛盾。

examples.en: The nurse found a vein in his arm to draw blood.
examples.zh: 護士在他手臂上找到一條靜脈來抽血。

examples.en: The novel is written in a humorous vein.
examples.zh: 這本小說以幽默的風格寫成。

examples.en: She filled the basin with warm water to wash her face.
examples.zh: 她在洗臉盆裡裝滿溫水洗臉。

examples.en: The Amazon basin is home to countless species.
examples.zh: 亞馬遜盆地是無數物種的家園。

examples.en: The weather was favourable for our picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣對我們的野餐很有利。

examples.en: The movie received favourable reviews from critics.
examples.zh: 這部電影獲得了評論家的好評。

examples.en: Coffee is a major commodity in Brazil's economy.
examples.zh: 咖啡是巴西經濟的主要商品。

examples.en: Clean water is becoming a scarce commodity in many regions.
examples.zh: 在許多地區，乾淨的水正成為稀缺商品。

examples.en: She takes vitamin supplements every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上服用維生素補充劑。

examples.en: He supplements his income by teaching online.
examples.zh: 他透過線上教學來補充收入。

examples.en: The bathroom floor is covered with blue tiles.
examples.zh: 浴室地板鋪滿了藍色瓷磚。

examples.en: They hired a worker to tile the roof.
examples.zh: 他們雇了一名工人來鋪屋頂瓦片。

examples.en: The kids are playing catch in the backyard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在後院玩傳接球。

examples.en: We planted a small vegetable garden in our backyard.
examples.zh: 我們在後院種了一個小菜園。

examples.en: The alarm on my phone is a reminder to take my medicine.
examples.zh: 手機鬧鐘是提醒我吃藥的提示。

examples.en: That old photo is a reminder of our childhood.
examples.zh: 那張舊照片是我們童年的回憶。

examples.en: She has been a loyal friend to me since high school.
examples.zh: 她從高中以來一直是我忠實的朋友。

examples.en: The company rewards employees who remain loyal during hard times.
examples.zh: 公司會獎勵在困難時期仍保持忠誠的員工。

examples.en: The airline agreed to compensate passengers for the long delay.
examples.zh: 航空公司同意賠償乘客因長時間延誤所受的損失。

examples.en: He works extra hours to compensate for his lack of experience.
examples.zh: 他加班工作來彌補自己經驗的不足。

examples.en: Poor organizational skills often lead to missed deadlines.
examples.zh: 組織能力不佳往往會導致錯過截止期限。

examples.en: The consultant reviewed the organizational structure of the whole department.
examples.zh: 顧問檢視了整個部門的組織架構。

examples.en: These shirts may shrink if you wash them in hot water.
examples.zh: 這些襯衫如果用熱水洗可能會縮水。

examples.en: The dog began to shrink back when the stranger approached.
examples.zh: 陌生人靠近時，那隻狗開始往後退縮。

examples.en: Solar power has become a major player in emerging markets.
examples.zh: 太陽能已成為新興市場的重要角色。

examples.en: Researchers are studying an emerging virus found in the region.
examples.zh: 研究人員正在研究該地區發現的一種新出現的病毒。

examples.en: He blushed with embarrassment when he forgot her name.
examples.zh: 他忘了她的名字，尷尬得臉都紅了。

examples.en: The typo on the cover was a major embarrassment for the publisher.
examples.zh: 封面上的錯字讓出版社非常難堪。

examples.en: The small bakery became profitable within its first year.
examples.zh: 這家小麵包店在開業第一年內就開始賺錢。

examples.en: Investing in staff training proved highly profitable for the firm.
examples.zh: 事實證明，投資員工訓練為公司帶來豐厚的利潤。

examples.en: She took vocal lessons to prepare for the musical.
examples.zh: 她上聲樂課，為音樂劇做準備。

examples.en: Residents have been vocal in their opposition to the new road.
examples.zh: 居民一直大聲表達反對這條新道路的立場。

examples.en: The hikers struggled across the rocky terrain.
examples.zh: 登山者艱難地穿越多岩石的地形。

examples.en: Maps of the terrain helped the rescue team plan their route.
examples.zh: 地形圖幫助救援隊規劃路線。

examples.en: The lecturer paused to answer a question from the audience.
examples.zh: 講師停下來回答聽眾的一個問題。

examples.en: She was invited to be a lecturer at the summer language program.
examples.zh: 她受邀擔任暑期語言課程的講師。

examples.en: Passengers will embark on the cruise ship at noon.
examples.zh: 乘客將在中午登上這艘遊輪。

examples.en: After graduation, he decided to embark on a career in journalism.
examples.zh: 畢業後，他決定展開新聞業的職業生涯。

examples.en: Science fiction is my favorite genre of film.
examples.zh: 科幻是我最喜歡的電影類型。

examples.en: The bookstore organizes novels by genre on the second floor.
examples.zh: 書店在二樓依類型陳列小說。

examples.en: His comment about the weather was completely irrelevant to our discussion.
examples.zh: 他關於天氣的那句話和我們的討論完全無關。

examples.en: Please remove any irrelevant details from the report.
examples.zh: 請把報告中任何不相干的細節刪除。

examples.en: He cut the meat into small chunks before cooking.
examples.zh: 他烹調前把肉切成小塊。

examples.en: A large chunk of her salary goes to rent.
examples.zh: 她薪水的一大部分都花在房租上。

examples.en: The manager summoned all the staff to an urgent meeting.
examples.zh: 經理召集所有員工開緊急會議。

examples.en: She tried to summon the courage to speak in public.
examples.zh: 她試著鼓起勇氣在公開場合發言。

examples.en: The migration of birds to warmer regions happens every autumn.
