examples.en: This river is a major feeder of the lake.
examples.zh: 這條河是該湖泊的主要支流。

examples.en: The volcano spewed lava and ash into the sky.
examples.zh: 火山向天空噴湧出岩漿和火山灰。

examples.en: The broken pipe spewed water all over the floor.
examples.zh: 破裂的管道把水噴得滿地都是。

examples.en: The majestic mountains rose above the clouds, leaving us speechless.
examples.zh: 雄偉的山脈高聳入雲，讓我們說不出話來。

examples.en: With a majestic wave of her hand, the queen silenced the crowd.
examples.zh: 女王莊嚴地揮了揮手，讓群眾安靜下來。

examples.en: She cleansed her face with a gentle foam every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上用溫和的泡沫洗面乳清潔臉部。

examples.en: The ritual was meant to cleanse the soul of all past sins.
examples.zh: 這個儀式旨在淨化靈魂中所有過去的罪惡。

examples.en: The field was filled with tall cannabis plants swaying in the wind.
examples.zh: 田野裡長滿了高大的大麻植株，隨風搖曳。

examples.en: Possession of cannabis is still illegal in many countries.
examples.zh: 在許多國家，持有大麻仍然是非法的。

examples.en: Apply this lotion to your dry skin twice a day.
examples.zh: 每天兩次將這款乳液塗抹在乾燥的皮膚上。

examples.en: The nurse used a medicated lotion to soothe the rash.
examples.zh: 護士使用藥用洗劑來舒緩皮疹。

examples.en: The party trained a new cadre of young leaders.
examples.zh: 該黨培訓了一批年輕的幹部。

examples.en: A small cadre of officers planned the entire operation.
examples.zh: 一小群軍官策劃了整個行動。

examples.en: The children encircled the storyteller, eager to hear more.
examples.zh: 孩子們圍繞著說書人，渴望聽到更多故事。

examples.en: A ring of tall trees encircles the old farmhouse.
examples.zh: 一圈高大的樹木環繞著那座老農舍。

examples.en: The baby giggled when I tickled her tummy.
examples.zh: 我搔寶寶的肚子時，她咯咯笑了起來。

examples.en: He lay on the sofa, rubbing his full tummy after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚飯後，他躺在沙發上，揉著吃飽的肚子。

examples.en: She bought a pair of silk knickers for the special occasion.
examples.zh: 她為這個特別場合買了一條絲質內褲。

examples.en: The hikers wore comfortable knickers that ended below the knee.
examples.zh: 登山者穿著及膝的舒適燈籠褲。

examples.en: I grabbed a sandwich from the deli on my way to work.
examples.zh: 我在上班途中從熟食店買了一個三明治。

examples.en: The deli on the corner sells fresh salads and cold cuts.
examples.zh: 轉角那家熟食店賣新鮮沙拉和冷盤。

examples.en: The band performed a short show during halftime.
examples.zh: 樂隊在中場休息時表演了一個簡短的節目。

examples.en: We grabbed snacks and stretched our legs at halftime.
examples.zh: 中場休息時，我們拿了點心並伸展雙腿。

examples.en: Winter in Siberia can last for more than six months.
examples.zh: 西伯利亞的冬天可以持續超過六個月。

examples.en: They took the Trans-Siberian Railway across Siberia.
examples.zh: 他們搭乘西伯利亞鐵路橫越西伯利亞。

examples.en: The company expended a huge amount of money on advertising.
examples.zh: 該公司在廣告上花費了大量金錢。

examples.en: Don't expend all your energy on the first mile of the race.
examples.zh: 不要把全部精力都消耗在比賽的第一英里上。

examples.en: The chef prepared grilled eel with a sweet soy glaze.
examples.zh: 廚師準備了塗上甜醬油的烤鰻魚。

examples.en: An eel slithered through the muddy water of the pond.
examples.zh: 一條鰻魚在池塘的泥水中滑行。

examples.en: The nurse filled the syringe with the vaccine.
examples.zh: 護士將疫苗裝入注射器。

examples.en: Doctors syringed the wound to remove dirt and bacteria.
examples.zh: 醫生用注射器沖洗傷口，以去除污垢和細菌。

examples.en: The bully's taunts made the younger boy cry.
examples.zh: 惡霸的嘲弄讓那個小男孩哭了。

examples.en: They taunted him for wearing a pink shirt to school.
examples.zh: 他們嘲笑他穿粉紅色襯衫去學校。

examples.en: A thick fog began to envelop the entire valley.
examples.zh: 濃霧開始籠罩整個山谷。

examples.en: She enveloped the baby in a warm blanket.
examples.zh: 她用溫暖的毯子把嬰兒裹起來。

examples.en: Many cultures revere their ancestors and hold ceremonies in their honor.
examples.zh: 許多文化崇敬祖先，並舉行儀式來紀念他們。

examples.en: The old professor is revered by students for his kindness.
examples.zh: 這位老教授因仁慈而受到學生們的尊敬。

examples.en: His constant lies created a deep distrust among his friends.
examples.zh: 他不斷說謊，在朋友之間造成了深深的不信任。

examples.en: She distrusted the offer because it seemed too good to be true.
examples.zh: 她不信任那個提議，因為它好得令人難以置信。

examples.en: Bananas are a well-known source of potassium.
examples.zh: 香蕉是眾所皆知的鉀來源。

examples.en: The doctor checked her potassium level after the blood test.
examples.zh: 血液檢查後，醫生檢查了她的鉀含量。

examples.en: The kidnappers gagged the hostage to prevent him from crying out.
examples.zh: 綁匪塞住人質的嘴，以防他大叫。

examples.en: The comedian's gag about his mother-in-law had the audience laughing.
examples.zh: 喜劇演員關於岳母的笑話讓觀眾哈哈大笑。

examples.en: The depletion of the ozone layer is a major environmental concern.
examples.zh: 臭氧層的耗損是重大的環境問題。

examples.en: Overfishing has led to the depletion of many fish stocks.
examples.zh: 過度捕撈已導致許多魚類資源枯竭。

examples.en: It's dangerous to generalize about people based on their nationality.
examples.zh: 根據國籍來概括一個民族是很危險的。

examples.en: The study's findings may not generalize to other populations.
examples.zh: 這項研究的結果可能無法推廣到其他族群。

examples.en: He gave up all his worldly possessions and became a monk.
examples.zh: 他捨棄所有世俗的財產，出家當了和尚。

examples.en: She seemed remarkably worldly for someone her age.
examples.zh: 以她的年紀來說，她顯得格外世故。

examples.en: The fencer parried her opponent's thrust with a quick circular motion.
examples.zh: 擊劍選手以快速的圓弧動作擋開對手的刺擊。

examples.en: When asked about the scandal, the politician parried the question with a joke.
examples.zh: 被問到醜聞時，那位政治人物用一個笑話迴避了問題。

examples.en: Shards of glass covered the floor after the window shattered.
examples.zh: 窗戶碎裂後，玻璃碎片散落一地。

examples.en: Archaeologists found pottery shards dating back thousands of years.
examples.zh: 考古學家發現了數千年前的陶器碎片。

examples.en: Few plants can survive in such an arid desert.
examples.zh: 在如此乾燥的沙漠中，很少植物能存活。

examples.en: The professor's arid lecture put half the class to sleep.
examples.zh: 教授枯燥乏味的講課讓半數學生睡著了。

examples.en: The film challenges traditional ideas of masculinity.
examples.zh: 這部影片挑戰了傳統的男子氣概觀念。

examples.en: He felt pressured to prove his masculinity by joining the football team.
examples.zh: 他感到壓力，要加入足球隊來證明自己的男子氣概。

examples.en: The invention of the transistor revolutionized electronics.
examples.zh: 電晶體的發明徹底改變了電子學。

examples.en: This old radio uses vacuum tubes instead of transistors.
examples.zh: 這台舊收音機使用真空管而不是電晶體。

examples.en: Maggots were crawling all over the rotting meat.
examples.zh: 蛆在腐爛的肉上爬來爬去。

examples.en: Anglers often use maggots as bait for fishing.
examples.zh: 釣魚者常用蛆當作魚餌。

examples.en: There was an unspoken agreement between them never to discuss the incident.
examples.zh: 他們之間有默契，從不討論那件事。

examples.en: Her unspoken fear was that she would fail the exam.
examples.zh: 她未說出口的恐懼是考試不及格。

examples.en: For more info, please visit our website.
examples.zh: 如需更多資訊，請瀏覽我們的網站。

examples.en: The receptionist gave me some useful info about the city.
examples.zh: 接待員給了我一些關於這座城市的有用資訊。

examples.en: The movie was a sleeper hit, becoming popular only months after its release.
examples.zh: 這部電影是票房黑馬，上映幾個月後才開始受歡迎。

examples.en: I booked a sleeper on the overnight train to Hualien.
examples.zh: 我訂了往花蓮的夜班火車臥鋪。

examples.en: My uncle has been driving a Honda for over ten years.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開本田汽車已經超過十年了。

examples.en: She bought a used Honda because it was affordable and reliable.
examples.zh: 她買了一輛二手本田，因為它價格實惠又可靠。

examples.en: Some countries have legalized same-sex marriage in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來一些國家已將同性婚姻合法化。

examples.en: The campaign aims to legalize the use of medical marijuana.
examples.zh: 這項運動旨在使醫療用大麻合法化。

examples.en: The outbreak of cholera was traced to contaminated water.
examples.zh: 霍亂的爆發被追溯至受污染的水源。

examples.en: Vaccines are available to help prevent cholera in high-risk areas.
examples.zh: 高風險地區有疫苗可幫助預防霍亂。

examples.en: The village is nestled in the foothills of the central mountains.
examples.zh: 這個村莊坐落在中央山脈的山麓。

examples.en: We hiked through the foothills before starting the steep climb.
examples.zh: 我們先健行穿過山麓小丘，然後才開始陡峭的攀登。

examples.en: Relations between the two neighbors have been strained since the argument.
examples.zh: 自從那次爭吵後，兩位鄰居的關係一直很緊張。

examples.en: She spoke in a strained voice, trying not to cry.
examples.zh: 她用勉強的聲音說話，努力忍住不哭。

examples.en: The splendor of the ancient palace left the tourists in awe.
examples.zh: 這座古代宮殿的壯麗讓遊客驚嘆不已。

examples.en: We watched the splendor of the sunset from the beach.
examples.zh: 我們從海灘上觀賞夕陽的壯麗景色。

examples.en: The sailor lost his balance and fell overboard.
examples.zh: 水手失去平衡，掉到船外。

examples.en: The company went overboard with decorations for the party.
examples.zh: 公司為派對的裝飾做得太過火了。

examples.en: The region has a temperate climate, with mild winters and cool summers.
examples.zh: 這個地區氣候溫和，冬天不冷，夏天涼爽。

examples.en: She always speaks in a temperate manner, even when she disagrees.
examples.zh: 她說話總是很溫和，即使不同意時也是如此。

examples.en: He traced his ancestry back to a small village in Ireland.
examples.zh: 他的祖先可以追溯到愛爾蘭的一個小村莊。

examples.en: Her mixed ancestry includes Chinese, Malay, and Dutch roots.
examples.zh: 她的混血血統包括華人、馬來人和荷蘭人的根源。

examples.en: The cleaning solution contains ammonia, which gives it a strong smell.
examples.zh: 這種清潔液含有氨水，因此有一股強烈的氣味。

examples.en: Ammonia is commonly used in the production of fertilizers.
examples.zh: 氨常用於生產肥料。

examples.en: The accelerated program allows students to finish their degree in three years.
examples.zh: 這個加速課程讓學生能在三年內完成學位。

examples.en: The car's accelerated speed made the passengers feel uneasy.
examples.zh: 車子加快的速度讓乘客感到不安。

examples.en: Please be mindful of your surroundings when you travel alone.
examples.zh: 獨自旅行時，請留意周遭環境。

examples.en: She is always mindful of other people's feelings.
examples.zh: 她總是顧慮到別人的感受。

examples.en: A herd of bison once roamed freely across the Great Plains.
examples.zh: 一群野牛曾經在大平原上自由漫遊。

examples.en: The bison is a symbol of strength and endurance in many cultures.
examples.zh: 在許多文化中，野牛是力量和耐力的象徵。

examples.en: The company's financial debacle left thousands of employees without jobs.
examples.zh: 該公司的財務崩潰讓數千名員工失業。

examples.en: The party turned into a debacle when the caterer failed to show up.
examples.zh: 當外燴業者沒出現時，派對變成了一場大失敗。

examples.en: The fire alarm blared loudly, forcing everyone to evacuate the building.
examples.zh: 火警警報大聲作響，迫使所有人撤離建築物。

examples.en: He blared his horn impatiently at the car in front of him.
examples.zh: 他不耐煩地對前面的車子大聲按喇叭。

examples.en: The dog slept peacefully in its kennel in the backyard.
examples.zh: 狗在後院的狗屋裡安穩地睡著。

examples.en: We boarded our puppy at a kennel while we were on vacation.
examples.zh: 我們度假時把小狗寄放在狗舍。

examples.en: The word 'happy' is a synonym for 'joyful'.
examples.zh: 「happy」是「joyful」的同義詞。

examples.en: Can you think of a synonym for 'big'?
examples.zh: 你能想到「big」的同義詞嗎？

examples.en: The town held a parade to celebrate its centennial anniversary.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮舉辦遊行慶祝百年紀念。

examples.en: A centennial celebration will take place next month at the university.
examples.zh: 下個月大學將舉行百年慶祝活動。

examples.en: Gamma is the third letter of the Greek alphabet.
examples.zh: gamma 是希臘字母的第三個字母。

examples.en: The scientist measured the gamma radiation emitted by the sample.
examples.zh: 科學家測量了樣本發出的伽馬輻射。

examples.en: The critics raved about the new restaurant's innovative dishes.
examples.zh: 評論家對這家新餐廳的創意菜餚讚不絕口。

examples.en: He raved angrily at the waiter for bringing the wrong order.
examples.zh: 他因為服務生送錯餐點而憤怒地對對方咆哮。

examples.en: Always check your rearview mirror before changing lanes.
examples.zh: 變換車道前一定要查看後視鏡。

examples.en: The rearview camera helps drivers see behind their vehicles.
examples.zh: 後視攝影機幫助駕駛人看到車後的狀況。

examples.en: We had grilled carp for dinner at the lakeside restaurant.
examples.zh: 我們在湖畔餐廳晚餐吃了烤鯉魚。

examples.en: Stop carping about the small stuff and focus on the big picture.
examples.zh: 別再挑剔小事了，把注意力放在大局上。

examples.en: The Pythagorean theorem is one of the most famous in geometry.
examples.zh: 畢氏定理是幾何學中最著名的定理之一。

examples.en: The mathematician proved a new theorem about prime numbers.
examples.zh: 這位數學家證明了一個關於質數的新定理。

examples.en: The researchers were able to synthesize the compound in the lab.
examples.zh: 研究人員能夠在實驗室中合成這種化合物。

examples.en: In her essay, she synthesized ideas from several different sources.
examples.zh: 她在文章中綜合了來自幾個不同來源的想法。

examples.en: She is a forgiving person who never holds a grudge.
examples.zh: 她是個寬容的人，從不記仇。

examples.en: This software is forgiving of minor user errors.
examples.zh: 這個軟體對使用者的輕微錯誤很寬容。

examples.en: Be careful not to swallow the pip when eating cherries.
examples.zh: 吃櫻桃時小心不要吞下果核。

examples.en: The chicken was suffering from a mild case of pip.
examples.zh: 這隻雞患有輕微的禽鳥舌喉炎。

examples.en: In programming, an integer is a whole number without a decimal point.
examples.zh: 在程式設計中，整數是不帶小數點的完整數字。

examples.en: The equation has solutions that are positive integers.
examples.zh: 這個方程式的解是正整數。

examples.en: The doctor examined her eyeball with a special light.
examples.zh: 醫生用特殊的燈檢查她的眼球。

examples.en: He eyeballed the stack of papers and sighed.
examples.zh: 他盯著那疊文件看，嘆了口氣。

examples.en: A rottweiler barked loudly at the mail carrier.
examples.zh: 一隻羅特韋爾犬對著郵差大聲吠叫。

examples.en: My neighbor's rottweiler is actually very gentle.
examples.zh: 我鄰居的羅特韋爾犬其實非常溫和。

examples.en: She has a quirky sense of humor that makes everyone laugh.
examples.zh: 她有一種古怪的幽默感，讓每個人都笑了。

examples.en: The cafe is known for its quirky decorations and friendly staff.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡館以古怪的裝飾和友善的員工聞名。

examples.en: Getting a visa turned out to be a huge hassle.
examples.zh: 辦簽證結果是一件非常麻煩的事。

examples.en: Stop hassling me about my homework; I'll do it later.
examples.zh: 別再為了我的功課煩我，我晚點會做。

examples.en: Don't take him seriously; he's just joshing with you.
examples.zh: 別把他當真，他只是跟你開玩笑。

examples.en: They joshed each other about their favorite teams.
examples.zh: 他們互相拿彼此最愛的球隊開玩笑。

examples.en: He wore a gray sweatshirt to the gym.
examples.zh: 他穿了一件灰色圓領長袖運動衫去健身房。

examples.en: She pulled her sweatshirt over her head.
examples.zh: 她把運動衫從頭上套下去。

examples.en: A throng of fans gathered outside the concert hall.
examples.zh: 一群粉絲聚集在音樂廳外。

examples.en: Shoppers thronged the streets during the holiday sale.
examples.zh: 假日特賣期間，購物人潮蜂擁至街上。

examples.en: The critics scoffed at his new design.
examples.zh: 評論家對他的新設計嗤之以鼻。

examples.en: He scoffed down his lunch and ran to class.
examples.zh: 他狼吞虎嚥地吃完午餐，然後跑去上課。

examples.en: She sewed the hem of her skirt by hand.
examples.zh: 她用手縫了裙子的折邊。

examples.en: He hemmed and hawed before finally answering.
examples.zh: 他哼啊哈的，最後才回答。

examples.en: The hikers explored a dark cavern deep in the mountain.
examples.zh: 登山客探索了山深處一個黑暗的巨穴。

examples.en: The basement felt like a cold, empty cavern.
examples.zh: 那個地下室感覺像一個寒冷空蕩的巨穴。

examples.en: Her athletic prowess earned her a scholarship.
examples.zh: 她的運動本領為她贏得了獎學金。

examples.en: The chef's culinary prowess impressed all the guests.
examples.zh: 這位廚師的烹飪超凡技術讓所有客人印象深刻。

examples.en: They bought too much booze for the party.
examples.zh: 他們為派對買了太多酒。

examples.en: He promised to stop boozing after the incident.
examples.zh: 那件事之後，他承諾不再豪飲。

examples.en: We sat around the campfire and told stories.
examples.zh: 我們圍坐在營火旁說故事。

examples.en: The campfire kept us warm on the cold night.
examples.zh: 營火讓我們在寒冷的夜晚保持溫暖。

examples.en: The doctor recommended an endoscopy to check her stomach.
examples.zh: 醫生建議做內窺鏡檢查來檢查她的胃。

examples.en: Endoscopy allows doctors to see inside the body without surgery.
examples.zh: 內窺鏡檢查讓醫生不用手術就能看到體內。

examples.en: A thick ooze leaked from the broken pipe.
examples.zh: 濃稠的滲流物從破裂的管子漏出來。

examples.en: Confidence oozed from her every move.
examples.zh: 她的每個動作都散發出自信。

examples.en: I mistakenly thought the meeting was on Monday.
examples.zh: 我錯誤地以為會議是星期一。

examples.en: He mistakenly took her umbrella by the door.
examples.zh: 他錯誤地拿走了門邊她的傘。

examples.en: The sky was filled with innumerable stars.
examples.zh: 天空佈滿了無數的星星。

examples.en: She has made innumerable friends over the years.
examples.zh: 這些年來她交了數不清的朋友。

examples.en: A scowl appeared on his face when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 他聽到消息時，臉上露出愁容。

examples.en: She scowled at the noisy children in the library.
examples.zh: 她對圖書館裡吵鬧的孩子皺眉。

examples.en: As the sun rose, mist began to transpire from the leaves.
examples.zh: 太陽升起時，水氣開始從葉子蒸發。

examples.en: It later transpired that the manager had known about the problem for months.
examples.zh: 後來才得知，經理已經知道這個問題好幾個月了。

examples.en: The preacher urged every sinner in the crowd to seek forgiveness.
examples.zh: 傳教士敦促人群中的每一位罪人尋求寬恕。

examples.en: In his sermon, he called himself the worst sinner of all.
examples.zh: 他在佈道中稱自己是最大的罪人。

examples.en: She smiled modestly when the teacher praised her essay.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚她的文章時，她靦腆地笑了。

examples.en: He lives modestly despite his considerable wealth.
examples.zh: 儘管他相當富有，生活卻很簡樸。

examples.en: The company was fined for making fraudulent claims about its products.
examples.zh: 該公司因對產品做出欺詐性聲明而被罰款。

examples.en: Police are investigating a fraudulent scheme that targeted elderly people.
examples.zh: 警方正在調查一起針對老年人的詐騙計畫。

examples.en: His addiction to gambling led to his downfall.
examples.zh: 他沉迷賭博，導致了他的衰敗。

examples.en: The scandal brought about the downfall of the entire government.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞導致了整個政府的垮台。

examples.en: The heavy box wouldn't budge no matter how hard we pushed.
examples.zh: 無論我們怎麼用力推，那個沉重的箱子都紋絲不動。

examples.en: She refused to budge from her position on the issue.
examples.zh: 她在這個問題上的立場毫不讓步。

examples.en: The special effects in the movie looked completely unreal.
examples.zh: 這部電影的特效看起來完全不真實。

examples.en: Walking through the abandoned amusement park felt surreal, almost unreal.
examples.zh: 走過那座廢棄的遊樂園感覺超現實，幾乎不真實。

examples.en: The old laptop is still usable for basic tasks like email.
examples.zh: 這台舊筆記型電腦仍然可用於電子郵件等基本任務。

examples.en: Please make sure the equipment is usable before the event.
examples.zh: 請確保設備在活動前是可用的。

examples.en: A judge must remain impartial and treat both sides fairly.
examples.zh: 法官必須保持公正，公平對待雙方。

examples.en: The committee sought an impartial expert to review the case.
examples.zh: 委員會尋求一位公正的專家來審查此案。

examples.en: After hiking for hours, she developed a painful blister on her heel.
examples.zh: 健行了幾個小時後，她的腳跟起了疼痛的水泡。

examples.en: The paint on the wall formed a blister due to moisture.
examples.zh: 牆上的油漆因潮濕而起了泡。

examples.en: The raging fire destroyed several buildings in the old town.
examples.zh: 猛烈的大火摧毀了老城區的幾棟建築。

examples.en: He had a raging headache and couldn't concentrate on work.
examples.zh: 他頭痛欲裂，無法專心工作。

examples.en: Leaving the lights on all day is wasteful and bad for the environment.
examples.zh: 整天開著燈是浪費的，而且對環境不好。

examples.en: The project was criticized for its wasteful use of resources.
examples.zh: 該項目因浪費資源而受到批評。

examples.en: The team celebrated their unbroken record of twelve wins.
examples.zh: 該隊慶祝他們十二連勝的不敗紀錄。

examples.en: A stretch of unbroken wilderness extends for miles beyond the river.
examples.zh: 一片連綿不斷的荒野延伸到河流以外好幾英里。

examples.en: She was dismissive of his suggestions, refusing to even consider them.
examples.zh: 她對他的建議不屑一顧，甚至拒絕考慮。

examples.en: His dismissive attitude toward the staff created a tense atmosphere.
examples.zh: 他對員工輕視的態度造成了緊張的氣氛。

examples.en: The wedding went smoothly without a single hitch.
examples.zh: 婚禮順利進行，沒有出現任何故障。

examples.en: They hitched the trailer to the back of the truck.
examples.zh: 他們把拖車掛在卡車後面。

examples.en: This spray is designed to repel mosquitoes and other insects.
examples.zh: 這種噴霧劑旨在驅趕蚊蟲和其他昆蟲。

examples.en: His rude behavior repelled everyone at the party.
examples.zh: 他粗魯的行為讓派對上的每個人都感到厭惡。

examples.en: The baby was born prematurely and needed special care.
examples.zh: 嬰兒早產，需要特別護理。

examples.en: Don't announce the results prematurely; we need to verify them first.
examples.zh: 不要過早宣布結果；我們需要先核實。

examples.en: The school does not condone bullying in any form.
examples.zh: 學校不容忍任何形式的霸凌。

examples.en: By staying silent, he seemed to condone their behavior.
examples.zh: 他保持沉默，似乎寬恕了他們的行為。

examples.en: The ferocious dog barked loudly at the strangers.
examples.zh: 那隻兇猛的狗對著陌生人大聲吠叫。

examples.en: A ferocious storm hit the coast last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一場猛烈的風暴襲擊了海岸。

examples.en: The doctor was hailed as a saviour after saving the child's life.
examples.zh: 醫生救了孩子的命後，被譽為救星。

examples.en: In the story, a mysterious stranger acts as the saviour of the village.
examples.zh: 在故事中，一位神秘的陌生人扮演了村莊的救世主。

examples.en: The company fired two engineers for suspected industrial espionage.
examples.zh: 公司因涉嫌工業間諜活動而解僱了兩名工程師。

examples.en: During the Cold War, espionage played a major role in international relations.
examples.zh: 冷戰期間，間諜活動在國際關係中扮演了重要角色。

examples.en: She sat by the lake in quiet contemplation for over an hour.
examples.zh: 她在湖邊安靜沉思了一個多小時。

examples.en: After much contemplation, he decided to turn down the job offer.
examples.zh: 經過深思熟慮後，他決定拒絕這份工作邀約。

examples.en: The frigid wind from the north made everyone hurry indoors.
examples.zh: 來自北方的寒風讓每個人都急忙躲進室內。

examples.en: She gave him a frigid stare and walked away without a word.
examples.zh: 她冷冷地瞪了他一眼，一言不發地走開。

examples.en: Our tour guide handed out a detailed itinerary for the five-day trip.
examples.zh: 導遊發給我們一份五天行程的詳細旅遊計畫。

examples.en: Does the itinerary include a stop at the museum?
examples.zh: 行程裡有包含參觀博物館嗎？

examples.en: I can't get this flipping printer to work properly.
examples.zh: 我沒辦法讓這台該死的印表機正常運作。

examples.en: Where did I put that flipping key?
examples.zh: 我把那把討厭的鑰匙放到哪裡去了？

examples.en: Tall cypress trees lined both sides of the narrow road.
examples.zh: 高大的柏樹排列在窄路的兩旁。

examples.en: The carpenter chose cypress for its resistance to rot.
examples.zh: 木匠選擇柏木，因為它耐腐蝕。

examples.en: Oil began to gush from the broken pipe.
examples.zh: 石油開始從破裂的管道中湧出。

examples.en: Fans gushed about the singer's new album on social media.
examples.zh: 粉絲在社群媒體上對這位歌手的新專輯讚不絕口。

examples.en: The twins looked so alike that they were almost indistinguishable.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎長得太像了，幾乎無法分辨。

examples.en: From a distance, the two buildings are indistinguishable.
examples.zh: 從遠處看，這兩棟建築物無法區別。

examples.en: Protesters used wooden boards to barricade the street.
examples.zh: 抗議者用木板在街上設置路障。

examples.en: Police barricaded the entrance to keep the crowd out.
examples.zh: 警方在入口設置路障以阻止人群進入。

examples.en: The volcano has been dormant for more than a century.
examples.zh: 這座火山已經休眠超過一個世紀。

examples.en: Some seeds remain dormant in the soil for years.
examples.zh: 有些種子會在土壤中休眠多年。

examples.en: Sporadic showers are expected throughout the afternoon.
examples.zh: 預計整個下午會有零星陣雨。

examples.en: The village has only sporadic access to the internet.
examples.zh: 這個村莊只有偶爾才能連上網路。

examples.en: They spent the morning trolling for fish in the deep lake.
examples.zh: 他們整個上午都在深湖裡用曳繩釣魚。

examples.en: Someone keeps trolling the forum with rude comments.
examples.zh: 有人不斷在論壇上留下粗魯的留言來引戰。

examples.en: She took a secretarial course to improve her office skills.
examples.zh: 她參加了秘書課程以提升辦公室技能。

examples.en: His secretarial duties include answering phones and scheduling meetings.
examples.zh: 他的秘書職責包括接電話和安排會議。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused a landslide that blocked the mountain road.
examples.zh: 大雨造成山崩，阻斷了山路。

examples.en: The candidate won the election by a landslide.
examples.zh: 這位候選人以壓倒性票數贏得選舉。

examples.en: The wrestler pinned his opponent to the mat in seconds.
examples.zh: 那位摔跤選手在幾秒內就把對手壓制在墊子上。

examples.en: As a child, he dreamed of becoming a professional wrestler.
examples.zh: 小時候，他夢想成為一名職業摔跤選手。

examples.en: The lowest temperature last night was just above freezing.
examples.zh: 昨晚的最低氣溫剛好在冰點以上。

examples.en: These items are placed on the lowest shelf for easy reach.
examples.zh: 這些物品放在最低的架子上，方便拿取。

examples.en: The team's chances of winning are diminishing with each loss.
examples.zh: 隨著每場敗仗，這支球隊獲勝的機會越來越小。

examples.en: We must act now before our resources start diminishing.
examples.zh: 我們必須在資源開始減少之前採取行動。

examples.en: The scholarship is awarded to deserving students each year.
examples.zh: 這項獎學金每年頒發給值得獎勵的學生。

examples.en: She felt she was deserving of a second chance.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己值得獲得第二次機會。

examples.en: The peaceful protest gradually degenerated into a violent riot.
examples.zh: 和平的抗議逐漸演變成暴力騷亂。

examples.en: Critics called the film a degenerate display of bad taste.
examples.zh: 評論家稱這部電影是低俗品味的墮落展現。

examples.en: The censored version of the movie removed all the violent scenes.
examples.zh: 這部電影的審查版本刪除了所有暴力場景。

examples.en: His letters home were heavily censored during the war.
examples.zh: 戰爭期間，他寄回家的信件受到嚴格審查。

examples.en: He used an ax to chop the firewood into smaller pieces.
examples.zh: 他用斧頭把木柴劈成小塊。

examples.en: The company decided to ax the project due to budget cuts.
examples.zh: 由於預算削減，公司決定砍掉這個專案。

examples.en: She spoke with deference to her elderly grandmother.
examples.zh: 她對年邁的祖母說話時帶著敬意。

examples.en: In deference to the local customs, we removed our shoes before entering.
examples.zh: 為了尊重當地習俗，我們進屋前脫了鞋。

examples.en: The old house had a creepy atmosphere that made everyone uneasy.
examples.zh: 那棟老房子有一種令人毛骨悚然的氣氛，讓每個人都感到不安。

examples.en: I don't like walking through this creepy alley at night.
examples.zh: 我不喜歡晚上走過這條陰森的小巷。

examples.en: He spread malicious rumors about his colleague to damage her reputation.
examples.zh: 他散布關於同事的惡意謠言來損害她的名譽。

examples.en: The software was designed to detect malicious files on your computer.
examples.zh: 這款軟體旨在偵測你電腦上的惡意檔案。

examples.en: The contract obligates the company to deliver the goods by Friday.
examples.zh: 合約規定公司必須在週五前交貨。

examples.en: I feel obligated to help my friend move to his new apartment.
examples.zh: 我覺得有義務幫朋友搬到新公寓。

examples.en: The waterfall cascaded down the rocky cliff into the pool below.
examples.zh: 瀑布從岩石峭壁傾瀉而下，落入下方的水池。

examples.en: A cascade of errors caused the system to crash.
examples.zh: 一連串的錯誤導致系統崩潰。

examples.en: Lying on the beach with a good book is pure bliss.
examples.zh: 躺在沙灘上讀一本好書是純粹的幸福。

examples.en: Their wedding day was filled with joy and bliss.
examples.zh: 他們的婚禮當天充滿了歡樂與幸福。

examples.en: The janitor cleans the school hallways every evening.
examples.zh: 管理員每天晚上打掃學校走廊。

examples.en: We thanked the janitor for fixing the broken light.
examples.zh: 我們感謝管理員修好了壞掉的燈。

examples.en: She removed the kernel from the peach before eating it.
examples.zh: 她吃桃子前把果核去掉。

examples.en: The kernel of his argument is that we need more funding.
examples.zh: 他論點的核心是我們需要更多資金。

examples.en: The witness's statement corroborated the suspect's alibi.
examples.zh: 證人的陳述證實了嫌疑犯的不在場證明。

examples.en: Recent studies corroborate the link between exercise and mental health.
examples.zh: 最近的研究證實了運動與心理健康之間的關聯。

examples.en: The term Anglo often refers to people of English descent.
examples.zh: Anglo 這個詞通常指英國後裔的人。

examples.en: Many Anglo traditions were brought to the region by early settlers.
examples.zh: 許多英國傳統是由早期移民帶到這個地區的。

examples.en: She persistently asked questions until she understood the topic.
examples.zh: 她堅持不懈地提問，直到她理解這個主題。

examples.en: The dog persistently barked at the mailman every morning.
examples.zh: 那隻狗每天早上都對著郵差不停地叫。

examples.en: The speaker's words incited the crowd to protest.
examples.zh: 演講者的話煽動群眾抗議。

examples.en: He was arrested for inciting violence during the rally.
examples.zh: 他因在集會中煽動暴力而被逮捕。

examples.en: We found a quiet campsite near the lake and set up our tent.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊找到一個安靜的營地，並搭起了帳篷。

examples.en: The campsite provides showers and a small store for campers.
examples.zh: 這個營地提供淋浴設施和給露營者的小商店。

examples.en: It is inconceivable that she would forget her own birthday.
examples.zh: 她竟然會忘記自己的生日，真是難以置信。

examples.en: The idea of traveling to Mars seemed inconceivable decades ago.
examples.zh: 幾十年前，去火星旅行的想法似乎難以想像。

examples.en: If you don't submit your assignment on time, you will forfeit your grade.
examples.zh: 如果你不按時交作業，你將會喪失成績。

examples.en: The team had to forfeit the game because too many players were injured.
examples.zh: 由於太多球員受傷，該隊不得不棄權比賽。

examples.en: The suspect claimed he was coerced into signing the confession.
examples.zh: 嫌疑犯聲稱他是被強迫簽下自白書的。

examples.en: You cannot coerce someone into changing their beliefs.
examples.zh: 你不能強迫別人改變他們的信仰。

examples.en: The pizza was too oily and left grease on my fingers.
examples.zh: 這披薩太油了，讓我的手指沾滿油脂。

examples.en: He gave an oily smile and promised to help, but I didn't trust him.
examples.zh: 他油嘴滑舌地笑著答應幫忙，但我不信任他。

examples.en: The mounted police patrolled the streets during the parade.
examples.zh: 騎警在遊行期間巡邏街道。

examples.en: She mounted the photograph on a piece of cardboard for display.
examples.zh: 她把照片裱在一塊紙板上展示。

examples.en: We often go swimming at the lake in midsummer.
examples.zh: 我們經常在仲夏時去湖裡游泳。

examples.en: The midsummer festival features bonfires and dancing.
examples.zh: 仲夏節慶有營火和舞蹈。

examples.en: The washer in the faucet needs to be replaced to stop the leak.
examples.zh: 水龍頭裡的墊圈需要更換才能止漏。

examples.en: She loaded the dirty clothes into the washer and started the cycle.
examples.zh: 她把髒衣服放進洗衣機，然後啟動洗衣程序。

examples.en: The manager decided to disband the project team after the budget was cut.
examples.zh: 預算被削減後，經理決定解散專案團隊。

examples.en: After the concert, the band announced they would disband at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 演唱會後，樂團宣布將在年底解散。

examples.en: The restaurant is held in high repute for its excellent service.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳因其優質服務而享有盛譽。

examples.en: He is reputed to be the best lawyer in the city.
examples.zh: 他被認為是城裡最好的律師。

examples.en: She cleverly avoided the traffic by taking a side road.
examples.zh: 她巧妙地走小路避開了車潮。

examples.en: The puzzle was cleverly designed to challenge even experts.
examples.zh: 這個謎題設計得很巧妙，連專家都覺得有挑戰性。

examples.en: The fire crackled and sent sparks into the night sky.
examples.zh: 火堆劈啪作響，火花飛向夜空。

examples.en: Old paint on the wall began to crackle and peel.
examples.zh: 牆上的舊漆開始龜裂剝落。

examples.en: His answer was a clear evasion of the question.
examples.zh: 他的回答明顯是在迴避問題。

examples.en: The businessman was fined for tax evasion.
examples.zh: 那名商人因逃漏稅而被罰款。

examples.en: She spread a white tablecloth over the dining table.
examples.zh: 她在餐桌上鋪了一條白色桌布。

examples.en: The tablecloth was stained with red wine.
examples.zh: 桌布被紅酒弄髒了。

examples.en: He gave his daughter an affectionate hug before she left for school.
examples.zh: 女兒上學前，他給了她一個深情的擁抱。

examples.en: They exchanged affectionate glances across the room.
examples.zh: 他們在房間兩頭交換了充滿愛意的眼神。

examples.en: The hotel offers free charging for electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供電動車免費充電服務。

examples.en: My phone battery is low, so I need to find a charging station.
examples.zh: 我的手機電量很低，所以需要找一個充電站。

examples.en: They plan to refurbish the old library into a community center.
examples.zh: 他們計劃將舊圖書館翻修成社區中心。

examples.en: The company refurbished its offices with new furniture and paint.
examples.zh: 公司用新家具和油漆重新裝修了辦公室。

examples.en: The mother sang lullabies to her unborn child.
examples.zh: 母親對未出生的孩子唱搖籃曲。

examples.en: Smoking during pregnancy can harm the unborn baby.
examples.zh: 懷孕期間吸菸會危害未出生的胎兒。

examples.en: She pushed the stroller along the park path.
examples.zh: 她推著嬰兒車沿著公園小徑走。

examples.en: The stroller has a canopy to protect the baby from the sun.
examples.zh: 這輛嬰兒車有遮陽篷，可以保護寶寶免受陽光照射。

examples.en: The knight vowed to slay the dragon and save the village.
examples.zh: 騎士發誓要殺死巨龍，拯救村莊。

examples.en: Her performance at the talent show absolutely slayed.
examples.zh: 她在才藝表演上的表現簡直太精彩了。

examples.en: The calm surface of the lake was deceptive; the current was strong.
examples.zh: 湖面平靜是騙人的，水流其實很強勁。

examples.en: He used deceptive tactics to win the game.
examples.zh: 他使用欺騙手段贏得比賽。

examples.en: The forest was densely packed with tall trees.
examples.zh: 森林裡密密麻麻地長滿了高大的樹木。

examples.en: The city is densely populated, with many high-rise buildings.
examples.zh: 這座城市人口稠密，有許多高樓大廈。

examples.en: He wrote a treatise on the history of philosophy.
examples.zh: 他寫了一篇關於哲學史的論文。

examples.en: The professor published a treatise about climate change.
examples.zh: 教授發表了一篇關於氣候變遷的專著。

examples.en: The flu is highly contagious and spreads quickly in crowded places.
examples.zh: 流感傳染性很強，在擁擠的地方傳播得很快。

examples.en: Her laughter was so contagious that everyone in the room smiled.
examples.zh: 她的笑聲很有感染力，房間裡的每個人都笑了。

examples.en: Yelling at employees is counterproductive and lowers morale.
examples.zh: 對員工大吼大叫會適得其反，降低士氣。

examples.en: Skipping breakfast to lose weight can be counterproductive.
examples.zh: 為了減肥而不吃早餐可能會適得其反。

examples.en: The teacher enlightened us about the causes of the French Revolution.
examples.zh: 老師向我們闡明了法國大革命的起因。

examples.en: Could you enlighten me on how this software works?
examples.zh: 你能為我說明一下這個軟體如何運作嗎？

examples.en: The parochial school is run by the local church.
examples.zh: 這所教區學校由當地教會經營。

examples.en: His parochial attitude prevents him from seeing the bigger picture.
examples.zh: 他目光偏狹的態度使他看不到全局。

examples.en: An onlooker called the police when she saw the accident.
examples.zh: 一名旁觀者看到事故後報了警。

examples.en: The onlookers watched in silence as the firefighters worked.
examples.zh: 旁觀者默默地看著消防員工作。

examples.en: The surfer rode a huge wave near the pier.
examples.zh: 衝浪者在碼頭附近衝上巨浪。

examples.en: Surfers often check the weather forecast before heading to the beach.
examples.zh: 衝浪者去海灘前常會查看天氣預報。

examples.en: The rooster crowed loudly at dawn, waking the whole farm.
examples.zh: 公雞在黎明時大聲啼叫，吵醒了整個農場。

examples.en: We saw a colorful rooster strutting around the yard.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻色彩鮮豔的公雞在院子裡昂首闊步。

examples.en: The controlling shareholder has the final say in major decisions.
examples.zh: 控股股東對重大決策有最終決定權。

examples.en: She plays a controlling role in the project's direction.
examples.zh: 她在專案方向上扮演控制的角色。

examples.en: The monk lived an austere life with few possessions.
examples.zh: 這位僧侶過著簡樸的生活，幾乎沒有財產。

examples.en: The austere decor of the room made it feel cold and unwelcoming.
examples.zh: 房間簡樸的裝飾讓人感到寒冷且不受歡迎。

examples.en: As a layman, I find the legal documents hard to understand.
examples.zh: 作為門外漢，我覺得這些法律文件很難理解。

examples.en: The book explains complex science in terms a layman can grasp.
examples.zh: 這本書用門外漢能理解的術語解釋複雜的科學。

examples.en: The warning light on the dashboard started flashing.
examples.zh: 儀表板上的警示燈開始閃爍。

examples.en: He placed his coffee on the dashboard and it spilled.
examples.zh: 他把咖啡放在儀表板上，結果灑了出來。

examples.en: The rescuer pulled the child from the icy water.
examples.zh: 救助者把小孩從冰冷的水中拉出來。

examples.en: Rescuers worked through the night to find survivors.
examples.zh: 救助者連夜工作以尋找生還者。

examples.en: The foreign film had subtitles in English and Chinese.
examples.zh: 這部外國電影有英文和中文兩種字幕。

examples.en: She prefers to watch movies with subtitles to improve her language skills.
examples.zh: 她喜歡看有字幕的電影來提升語言能力。

examples.en: The budding artist sold her first painting at the fair.
examples.zh: 這位初露頭角的藝術家在博覽會上賣出了她的第一幅畫。

examples.en: Budding entrepreneurs often seek advice from experienced mentors.
examples.zh: 初露頭角的創業者常向經驗豐富的導師尋求建議。

examples.en: He had a terrible hangover after the party and stayed in bed all day.
examples.zh: 派對後他宿醉得很嚴重，整天都躺在床上。

examples.en: The old building is a hangover from the colonial era.
examples.zh: 這棟老建築是殖民時代遺留下來的。

examples.en: She was busily typing on her laptop when I called.
examples.zh: 我打電話時，她正忙著在筆記型電腦上打字。

examples.en: The bees buzzed busily around the garden.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花園裡忙碌地嗡嗡作響。

examples.en: The sinking of the ship was caused by a sudden storm.
examples.zh: 這艘船的沉沒是由突如其來的風暴造成的。

examples.en: He felt a sinking feeling in his stomach when he heard the news.
examples.zh: 他聽到這個消息時，感到一陣不安。

examples.en: Her complaint went unheard by the management.
examples.zh: 她的投訴沒有被管理層聽到。

examples.en: The voice of the minority often remains unheard in such debates.
examples.zh: 在這樣的辯論中，少數人的聲音往往未被傾聽。

examples.en: The aristocrat owned vast lands and a grand castle.
examples.zh: 這位貴族擁有廣闊的土地和一座宏偉的城堡。

examples.en: Aristocrats in the past held significant political power.
examples.zh: 過去的貴族掌握著重要的政治權力。

examples.en: The documentary was both entertaining and instructive.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片既有趣又富有教育意義。

examples.en: His mistakes serve as an instructive lesson for others.
examples.zh: 他的錯誤對他人來說是一個有益的教訓。

examples.en: Proper etiquette requires you to thank the host.
examples.zh: 適當的禮儀要求你感謝主人。

examples.en: Business etiquette varies greatly from country to country.
examples.zh: 商業禮儀因國家而異，差異很大。

examples.en: The cultivated fields stretched as far as the eye could see.
examples.zh: 耕種過的田野一望無際。

examples.en: She is a cultivated woman who enjoys classical music and art.
examples.zh: 她是一位有教養的女性，喜歡古典音樂和藝術。

examples.en: The project ended in a miscarriage after months of poor planning.
examples.zh: 這個計畫在數月規劃不周之後以失敗收場。

examples.en: She was devastated when the doctor told her she had suffered a miscarriage.
examples.zh: 醫生告訴她流產時，她悲痛欲絕。

examples.en: The soup tasted horribly salty, so nobody finished it.
examples.zh: 那碗湯鹹得可怕，所以沒有人喝完。

examples.en: He felt horribly embarrassed after forgetting her name.
examples.zh: 他忘記她的名字後，感到非常尷尬。

examples.en: After twisting his ankle, he could only hobble to the door.
examples.zh: 扭傷腳踝後，他只能一跛一跛地走到門口。

examples.en: Heavy regulations hobble small businesses trying to grow.
examples.zh: 繁重的法規阻礙了想要成長的小企業。

examples.en: The reformed thief now runs a program helping troubled teens.
examples.zh: 那名改過自新的小偷現在經營一個幫助問題青少年的計畫。

examples.en: She attends a reformed church near her home every Sunday.
examples.zh: 她每個星期天都去住家附近的改革宗教會。

examples.en: The piglet squealed loudly when the farmer picked it up.
examples.zh: 農夫把小豬抱起來時，牠大聲尖叫。

examples.en: Under pressure from the police, the suspect finally squealed on his partners.
examples.zh: 在警方的壓力下，嫌犯終於供出了他的同夥。

examples.en: A beaver built a dam across the narrow stream.
examples.zh: 一隻海狸在狹窄的溪流上築了一道壩。

examples.en: She bought a warm beaver hat for the cold winter.
examples.zh: 她買了一頂保暖的海狸毛帽來度過寒冬。

examples.en: They sailed to the island and thence to the mainland.
examples.zh: 他們航行到那座島，再從那裡前往大陸。

examples.en: He was careless with money; thence came all his financial troubles.
examples.zh: 他對金錢漫不經心，他的財務問題因此而起。

examples.en: Climate change is one of the greatest challenges facing humankind.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷是人類面臨的最大挑戰之一。

examples.en: For centuries, humankind has dreamed of traveling to the stars.
examples.zh: 數百年來，人類一直夢想著前往星辰旅行。

examples.en: Wearing a seatbelt is obligatory for everyone in the car.
examples.zh: 車上每個人都必須繫安全帶。

examples.en: Attendance at the safety training is obligatory for all new staff.
examples.zh: 所有新進員工都必須參加安全訓練。

examples.en: Children need to learn how to stay safe in cyberspace.
examples.zh: 孩子們需要學習如何在網路上保持安全。

examples.en: Millions of people meet and share ideas in cyberspace every day.
examples.zh: 每天有數百萬人在網路上相遇並分享想法。

examples.en: The dancer's graceful movements mesmerized the entire audience.
examples.zh: 那位舞者優美的動作迷住了全場觀眾。

examples.en: He tried to mesmerize the patient to help her relax.
examples.zh: 他試著對病人施催眠術，幫助她放鬆。

examples.en: The new stadium is massively larger than the old one.
examples.zh: 新體育場比舊的大得多。

examples.en: The company invested massively in renewable energy last year.
examples.zh: 該公司去年大規模投資再生能源。

examples.en: He gets moody whenever he skips lunch.
examples.zh: 他每次不吃午餐就會心情不好。

examples.en: Her moody teenage son barely spoke at dinner.
examples.zh: 她那喜怒無常的青少年兒子晚餐時幾乎不說話。

examples.en: The disputed land has been claimed by two neighboring families.
examples.zh: 這塊有爭議的土地被兩個鄰近家族宣稱所有。

examples.en: Scientists continue to study the disputed results of the experiment.
examples.zh: 科學家持續研究該實驗有爭議的結果。

examples.en: Bomb experts worked carefully to defuse the old device.
examples.zh: 拆彈專家小心翼翼地拆除那枚舊裝置的引信。

examples.en: She told a joke to defuse the tension in the room.
examples.zh: 她講了一個笑話來緩和房間裡的緊張氣氛。

examples.en: He accepted a posting to the company's office in Japan.
examples.zh: 他接受了派駐日本分公司的職務。

examples.en: Her posting about the lost dog was shared hundreds of times.
examples.zh: 她關於走失狗狗的貼文被分享了好幾百次。

examples.en: Termites had eaten through the wooden floor of the old house.
examples.zh: 白蟻已經蛀穿了老房子的木地板。

examples.en: The inspector warned us that a termite problem could cost thousands to fix.
examples.zh: 檢查員警告我們，白蟻問題可能要花上好幾千元才能修好。

examples.en: The soldiers developed a deep sense of brotherhood during training.
examples.zh: 士兵們在訓練期間培養出深厚的手足情誼。

examples.en: The union promotes brotherhood among workers of all backgrounds.
examples.zh: 這個工會促進各種背景勞工之間的情誼。

examples.en: Her piety was evident in the way she cared for the poor.
examples.zh: 她照顧窮人的方式明顯展現出她的虔誠。

examples.en: The old temple is a symbol of the community's piety.
examples.zh: 這座古老的寺廟是社區虔誠信仰的象徵。

examples.en: Opium was once widely used as a painkiller in medicine.
examples.zh: 鴉片曾經在醫學上被廣泛用作止痛藥。

examples.en: The government launched a campaign to stop opium smuggling.
examples.zh: 政府展開行動，遏止鴉片走私。

examples.en: The company will reimburse you for all travel expenses within two weeks.
examples.zh: 公司會在兩週內償還你所有的差旅費用。

examples.en: Please keep your receipts so we can reimburse the full amount.
examples.zh: 請保留收據，以便我們全額償還。

examples.en: Every February, the city hosts a colorful carnival with parades and music.
examples.zh: 每年二月，這座城市都會舉辦豐富多彩的嘉年華會，有遊行和音樂。

examples.en: The children enjoyed the carnival rides and games at the fair.
examples.zh: 孩子們在園遊會上享受嘉年華的遊樂設施和遊戲。

examples.en: Workers used tar to patch the cracks in the road.
examples.zh: 工人們用柏油修補道路上的裂縫。

examples.en: The old roof was covered with tar to prevent leaks.
examples.zh: 舊屋頂塗上了焦油以防漏水。

examples.en: The mayor will inaugurate the new library next Monday.
examples.zh: 市長將於下週一為新圖書館舉行啟用典禮。

examples.en: They plan to inaugurate the festival with a fireworks display.
examples.zh: 他們計劃以煙火表演揭開慶典的序幕。

examples.en: She showed a natural aptitude for learning foreign languages.
examples.zh: 她展現出學習外語的天賦。

examples.en: His aptitude for math impressed all his teachers.
examples.zh: 他的數學才能讓所有老師印象深刻。

examples.en: The hike was uphill most of the way, but the view was worth it.
examples.zh: 這趟健行大部分路程都是上坡，但風景值得。

examples.en: She faced an uphill battle to convince her boss.
examples.zh: 她面臨一場艱難的戰鬥，要說服她的老闆。

examples.en: The kitchen was covered in filth after the party.
examples.zh: 派對結束後，廚房裡滿是汙穢。

examples.en: He was disgusted by the filth in the abandoned house.
examples.zh: 他被那棟廢棄房屋裡的髒亂噁心到了。

examples.en: Someone tried to tamper with the evidence before the trial.
examples.zh: 有人在審判前試圖篡改證據。

examples.en: Do not tamper with the settings on the machine.
examples.zh: 不要擅自更動機器的設定。

examples.en: There was a momentary pause before she answered the question.
examples.zh: 她回答問題前有短暫的停頓。

examples.en: A momentary lapse in concentration caused the accident.
examples.zh: 一時的分心導致了這場意外。

examples.en: The conservationist worked tirelessly to protect the endangered species.
examples.zh: 這位自然資源保護論者不知疲倦地保護瀕危物種。

examples.en: As a conservationist, she advocates for cleaner oceans.
examples.zh: 作為一名自然資源保護論者，她倡導更乾淨的海洋。

examples.en: His scholastic achievements earned him a scholarship to a top university.
examples.zh: 他的學業成就為他贏得了頂尖大學的獎學金。

examples.en: The school focuses on both scholastic and extracurricular activities.
examples.zh: 這所學校同時注重學業和課外活動。

examples.en: The children munched on cookies while watching cartoons.
examples.zh: 孩子們一邊看卡通一邊大聲咀嚼餅乾。

examples.en: I could hear him munching an apple in the next room.
examples.zh: 我聽到他在隔壁房間大聲嚼蘋果。

examples.en: His silly hat made him the mockery of the whole class.
examples.zh: 他那頂滑稽的帽子讓他成為全班的笑柄。

examples.en: The trial was a mockery of justice, according to the protesters.
examples.zh: 抗議者認為那場審判是對正義的嘲弄。

examples.en: The driver had to swerve to avoid hitting a dog.
examples.zh: 駕駛人必須突然轉向以避免撞到一隻狗。

examples.en: The car swerved off the road and into a ditch.
examples.zh: 車子突然偏離道路，衝進溝裡。

examples.en: We heard a lark singing high above the meadow.
examples.zh: 我們聽到一隻雲雀在草原上空高聲歌唱。

examples.en: They went on a lark to the beach for the day.
examples.zh: 他們一時興起去海灘玩了一天。

examples.en: The snake's venom can be deadly if not treated quickly.
examples.zh: 如果不及時治療，這條蛇的毒液可能致命。

examples.en: She spoke with venom about her former colleague.
examples.zh: 她滿懷惡意地談論她以前的同事。

examples.en: Good scheduling is key to finishing the project on time.
examples.zh: 良好的行程安排是準時完成專案的關鍵。

examples.en: The software helps with scheduling meetings across time zones.
examples.zh: 這套軟體有助於安排跨時區的會議。

examples.en: The villain in the story committed vile acts against innocent people.
examples.zh: 故事中的反派對無辜的人犯下卑鄙的行為。

examples.en: A vile smell came from the garbage bin.
examples.zh: 垃圾桶散發出惡臭。

examples.en: The hotel lobby was decorated with plush velvet sofas.
examples.zh: 飯店大廳裝飾著豪華的天鵝絨沙發。

examples.en: The plush fabric of the curtains felt soft to the touch.
examples.zh: 窗簾的長毛絨布料摸起來很柔軟。

examples.en: Members receive preferential treatment when booking tickets.
examples.zh: 會員在訂票時享有優先待遇。

examples.en: The company offered preferential rates to long-term clients.
examples.zh: 公司為長期客戶提供優惠費率。

examples.en: The picture on the wall is skew because the nail is loose.
examples.zh: 牆上的畫歪了，因為釘子鬆了。

examples.en: Don't skew the data to make your argument sound stronger.
examples.zh: 不要曲解數據來讓你的論點聽起來更有力。

examples.en: After the insult, she retaliated with a sharp comeback.
examples.zh: 受到侮辱後，她以尖銳的反駁回敬。

examples.en: The company retaliated against the lawsuit by filing its own.
examples.zh: 公司對這起訴訟展開報復，提出了自己的訴訟。

examples.en: This painting typifies the style of the artist's early period.
examples.zh: 這幅畫代表了這位藝術家早期階段的風格。

examples.en: His behavior typifies everything I dislike about modern politics.
examples.zh: 他的行為象徵了我對現代政治所有不喜歡的地方。

examples.en: The old man was called a lunatic for his strange ideas.
examples.zh: 那位老人因為想法古怪而被稱為瘋子。

examples.en: Driving at that speed is completely lunatic.
examples.zh: 以那種速度開車完全是瘋了。

examples.en: The building looks old externally, but it's modern inside.
examples.zh: 這棟建築外觀看起來很舊，但裡面很現代。

examples.en: Externally, the two phones look identical.
examples.zh: 從外表看，這兩支手機一模一樣。

examples.en: The chauffeur opened the door for the guests.
examples.zh: 司機為客人開門。

examples.en: She hired a chauffeur to drive her to the airport.
examples.zh: 她雇了一名司機載她去機場。

examples.en: The gilded frame made the painting look more expensive.
examples.zh: 鍍金的畫框讓這幅畫看起來更昂貴。

examples.en: Behind the gilded facade, the company was struggling.
examples.zh: 在光鮮亮麗的表面背後，公司其實經營得很辛苦。

examples.en: The hurricane caused unimaginable damage to the coastal town.
examples.zh: 颶風對這座沿海城鎮造成了無法想像的破壞。

examples.en: It's unimaginable that anyone could survive such a fall.
examples.zh: 有人能從那樣的墜落中倖存，真是不可思議。

examples.en: A bright yellow canary sang in the cage.
examples.zh: 一隻鮮黃色的金絲雀在籠子裡歌唱。

examples.en: She wore a canary dress to the summer party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件淡黃色的洋裝去參加夏日派對。

examples.en: The old elm tree provided shade for the entire yard.
examples.zh: 那棵老榆樹為整個院子提供了遮蔭。

examples.en: They made a sturdy table from elm wood.
examples.zh: 他們用榆木做了一張堅固的桌子。

examples.en: She felt a stinging pain when she touched the wound.
examples.zh: 她碰到傷口時感到一陣刺痛。

examples.en: His stinging remarks left her in tears.
examples.zh: 他尖銳的批評讓她哭了。

examples.en: The story of Noah's ark is told in the Bible.
examples.zh: 挪亞方舟的故事記載在聖經中。

examples.en: Children love the story of the ark and the animals.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡方舟和動物的故事。

examples.en: The hikers continued onward despite the rain.
examples.zh: 儘管下雨，健行者仍繼續前進。

examples.en: From that day onward, she never looked back.
examples.zh: 從那天起，她再也沒有回頭。

examples.en: The body was taken to the morgue for identification.
examples.zh: 遺體被送到停屍間供辨認。

examples.en: The detective visited the morgue to examine the evidence.
examples.zh: 偵探前往停屍間檢查證據。

examples.en: The clutter on her desk made it hard to find anything.
examples.zh: 她桌上的雜亂讓東西很難找。

examples.en: Don't clutter the hallway with boxes.
examples.zh: 不要把箱子堆在走廊上，弄得一團亂。

examples.en: The traffic light turned amber, so we slowed down.
examples.zh: 交通號誌轉為黃燈，所以我們減速了。

examples.en: She wore a necklace made of amber.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條琥珀項鍊。

examples.en: The two singers performed a beautiful duet.
examples.zh: 這兩位歌手表演了一首優美的二重唱。

examples.en: They played a piano duet at the concert.
examples.zh: 他們在音樂會上演奏了鋼琴二重奏。

examples.en: The police raided an illegal brothel in the city.
examples.zh: 警方突襲了市區一家非法妓院。

examples.en: She wrote a novel about life in a brothel.
examples.zh: 她寫了一本關於妓院生活的小說。

examples.en: The ancient Romans called the tribes outside their empire barbarians.
examples.zh: 古羅馬人稱帝國外的部落為野蠻人。

examples.en: His barbarian manners shocked the polite guests.
examples.zh: 他野蠻的舉止讓有禮的客人們大吃一驚。

examples.en: Due to the accident, we had to take a detour to reach the airport.
examples.zh: 由於事故，我們不得不繞道才能到達機場。

examples.en: The detour added nearly thirty minutes to our journey.
examples.zh: 繞道使我們的旅程多花了近三十分鐘。

examples.en: You can adjust the seat manually or use the electronic controls.
examples.zh: 你可以手動調整座椅，或使用電子控制。

examples.en: She manually entered each customer's data into the system.
examples.zh: 她手動將每位客戶的資料輸入系統。

examples.en: The bride wore a crimson dress that matched the autumn leaves.
examples.zh: 新娘穿著一件與秋葉相襯的深紅色連衣裙。

examples.en: His face turned crimson with embarrassment when he realized his mistake.
examples.zh: 當他意識到自己的錯誤時，羞愧得滿臉通紅。

examples.en: The teacher read a fable about a clever fox to the class.
examples.zh: 老師向全班朗讀了一則關於聰明狐狸的寓言。

examples.en: His excuse for being late was a complete fable that no one believed.
examples.zh: 他遲到的藉口完全是編造的謊言，沒有人相信。

examples.en: We spotted a colorful pheasant hiding in the tall grass.
examples.zh: 我們發現一隻色彩鮮豔的雉雞躲在高草叢中。

examples.en: The restaurant serves roasted pheasant with seasonal vegetables.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳提供烤雉雞搭配時令蔬菜。

examples.en: The manager greeted the new employees with warmth and civility.
examples.zh: 經理以溫暖和禮貌迎接新員工。

examples.en: Even during the heated debate, both sides maintained a degree of civility.
examples.zh: 即使在激烈的辯論中，雙方仍保持一定程度的禮貌。

examples.en: My neighbor is an Albanian who moved here ten years ago.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居是一位十年前搬到這裡的阿爾巴尼亞人。

examples.en: She is fluent in Albanian and often translates for her family.
examples.zh: 她阿爾巴尼亞語說得很流利，經常為家人翻譯。

examples.en: The old house has a steep gable facing the street.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子有一個面向街道的陡峭山形牆。

examples.en: A small window was set into the gable to let in light.
examples.zh: 山形牆上開了一扇小窗戶以引入光線。

examples.en: The blacksmith shaped the hot iron with precise hammer strikes.
examples.zh: 鐵匠以精準的錘擊塑造熾熱的鐵。

examples.en: In the village, the blacksmith was also the one who repaired tools.
examples.zh: 在村裡，鐵匠也是負責修理工具的人。

examples.en: She teaches aerobics at the community center every Tuesday evening.
examples.zh: 她每週二晚上在社區中心教有氧運動。

examples.en: Doing aerobics regularly can improve your heart and lung health.
examples.zh: 定期做有氧運動可以改善你的心肺健康。

examples.en: The islander shared stories about the storms that often hit the coast.
examples.zh: 這位島民分享了關於經常襲擊海岸的風暴的故事。

examples.en: As an islander, he learned to swim before he could walk.
examples.zh: 身為島民，他在學會走路前就學會了游泳。

examples.en: The kickoff for the charity run is at eight in the morning.
examples.zh: 慈善路跑的開始時間是早上八點。

examples.en: The kickoff of the football game was delayed by heavy rain.
examples.zh: 足球賽的開球因大雨而延遲。

examples.en: The couple planned a romantic rendezvous at the beach at sunset.
examples.zh: 這對情侶計劃在日落時分於海灘進行浪漫的約會。

examples.en: The park is a popular rendezvous for local artists.
examples.zh: 這座公園是當地藝術家熱門的聚會地點。

examples.en: The grotesque mask in the museum frightened the young children.
examples.zh: 博物館裡那個怪異的面具嚇壞了年幼的孩子們。

examples.en: His grotesque sense of humor sometimes made people uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 他那怪誕的幽默感有時讓人感到不舒服。

examples.en: The flowering cherry trees attract many visitors in spring.
examples.zh: 開花的櫻花樹在春天吸引了許多遊客。

examples.en: This plant's flowering period lasts only a few weeks.
examples.zh: 這種植物的開花期只持續幾週。

examples.en: The doctor managed to stop the haemorrhage during surgery.
examples.zh: 醫生在手術中成功止住了出血。

examples.en: A severe haemorrhage can be life-threatening if not treated quickly.
examples.zh: 嚴重的大出血若不及時治療可能危及生命。

examples.en: I often reread my favorite novel to discover new details.
examples.zh: 我經常重讀我最愛的小說，以發現新的細節。

examples.en: Please reread the instructions carefully before assembling the furniture.
examples.zh: 組裝家具前請仔細重讀說明書。

examples.en: The medieval castle was surrounded by a deep moat filled with water.
examples.zh: 這座中世紀城堡被一條充滿水的深護城河環繞。

examples.en: Visitors can walk across the bridge that spans the moat.
examples.zh: 遊客可以走過橫跨護城河的橋樑。

examples.en: The coveted award is given to only one student each year.
examples.zh: 這個令人垂涎的獎項每年只頒給一位學生。

examples.en: She finally acquired the coveted position after years of hard work.
examples.zh: 經過多年的努力，她終於獲得了夢寐以求的職位。

examples.en: The negotiations ended in a deadlock after hours of discussion.
examples.zh: 經過數小時的討論，談判陷入僵局。

examples.en: Both parties refused to compromise, leaving the project in deadlock.
examples.zh: 雙方都拒絕妥協，使項目陷入停頓。

examples.en: She is a skillful negotiator who always finds a way to satisfy both sides.
examples.zh: 她是一位技巧嫻熟的談判者，總能找到讓雙方都滿意的方法。

examples.en: With a few skillful moves, the chef turned simple ingredients into a beautiful dish.
examples.zh: 憑著幾個巧妙的動作，廚師就把簡單的食材變成了一道漂亮的菜。

examples.en: She dreamed of traveling to faraway lands and experiencing different cultures.
examples.zh: 她夢想著去遙遠的地方旅行，體驗不同的文化。

examples.en: A faraway look came into his eyes as he remembered his childhood.
examples.zh: 當他回憶起童年時，眼神變得恍惚。

examples.en: A raccoon knocked over the trash can and scattered garbage all over the driveway.
examples.zh: 一隻浣熊弄倒了垃圾桶，把垃圾散落在車道上。

examples.en: The hat was trimmed with raccoon, giving it a luxurious look.
examples.zh: 這頂帽子用浣熊毛皮裝飾，看起來很奢華。

examples.en: She shaped the ground beef into small patties for the barbecue.
examples.zh: 她把絞碎的牛肉做成小餡餅，準備燒烤。

examples.en: The bakery sells delicious apple patties filled with cinnamon and raisins.
examples.zh: 這家麵包店賣美味的蘋果小餡餅，裡面包著肉桂和葡萄乾。

examples.en: Supposing it rains tomorrow, where will we hold the picnic?
examples.zh: 假使明天下雨，我們要在哪裡野餐？

examples.en: Supposing you were given a million dollars, what would you do first?
examples.zh: 假使你得到一百萬美元，你首先會做什麼？

examples.en: He wore a smug smile after winning the argument.
examples.zh: 贏得爭論後，他露出自鳴得意的笑容。

examples.en: Don't be so smug; you might not be right next time.
examples.zh: 別那麼自以為是；下次你可能就不對了。

examples.en: The wine tasting at the vineyard attracted many visitors.
examples.zh: 葡萄園的品酒會吸引了許多遊客。

examples.en: She took a small tasting of the soup to check the seasoning.
examples.zh: 她嘗了一小口湯，檢查調味。

examples.en: The firth was calm, reflecting the colors of the sunset.
examples.zh: 峽灣平靜，倒映著夕陽的色彩。

examples.en: Many species of birds migrate to the firth during winter.
examples.zh: 許多鳥類在冬季遷徙到這個河口。

examples.en: She spoke earnestly about the need to protect the environment.
examples.zh: 她誠摯地談到保護環境的必要性。

examples.en: He earnestly studied for the exam, hoping to get a scholarship.
examples.zh: 他認真地為考試讀書，希望能拿到獎學金。

examples.en: The mother sang sweetly to her baby, who soon fell asleep.
examples.zh: 母親甜美地對寶寶唱歌，寶寶很快就睡著了。

examples.en: She smiled sweetly and thanked everyone for coming.
examples.zh: 她甜甜地微笑，感謝大家的到來。

examples.en: Dallas is known for its vibrant economy and cultural attractions.
examples.zh: 達拉斯以其蓬勃的經濟和文化景點聞名。

examples.en: They flew to Dallas for a business conference last week.
examples.zh: 他們上週飛往達拉斯參加商務會議。

examples.en: We ordered beef tacos and guacamole for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐點了牛肉墨西哥煎玉米卷和酪梨醬。

examples.en: The food truck serves the best fish tacos in town.
examples.zh: 這輛餐車賣的魚肉墨西哥煎玉米卷是鎮上最好的。

examples.en: The switchboard operator connected the call to the manager's office.
examples.zh: 總機接線生將電話轉接到經理辦公室。

examples.en: He worked at the switchboard, directing calls to the appropriate departments.
examples.zh: 他在交換臺工作，將電話轉接到適當的部門。

examples.en: Full immersion in the language helped her learn quickly.
examples.zh: 完全沉浸在那種語言中幫助她學得很快。

examples.en: The baptism involved complete immersion in the water.
examples.zh: 洗禮包括完全浸入水中。

examples.en: Her diligence in studying paid off with excellent grades.
examples.zh: 她勤奮學習，獲得了優異的成績。

examples.en: The project was completed on time thanks to the team's diligence.
examples.zh: 由於團隊的勤奮，專案按時完成了。

examples.en: The two companies were accused of collusion to fix prices.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司被指控勾結操縱價格。

examples.en: There was no evidence of collusion between the officials.
examples.zh: 沒有證據顯示官員之間有共謀。

examples.en: The news of the accident saddened the entire community.
examples.zh: 事故的消息使整個社區感到悲傷。

examples.en: She saddened at the thought of leaving her friends behind.
examples.zh: 一想到要離開朋友們，她就感到憂愁。

examples.en: The antique vase turned out to be a sham, worth only a few dollars.
examples.zh: 那個古董花瓶結果是贗品，只值幾美元。

examples.en: He tried to sham illness to avoid going to school.
examples.zh: 他試圖裝病以逃避上學。

examples.en: She gave an exclamation of surprise when she saw the gift.
examples.zh: 當她看到禮物時，發出了一聲驚呼。

examples.en: The teacher reminded the students to use exclamation marks sparingly.
examples.zh: 老師提醒學生要少用驚嘆號。

examples.en: The rescue team had to abort the mission due to the storm.
examples.zh: 由於暴風雨，救援隊不得不中止任務。

examples.en: She was heartbroken when the project aborted at the last minute.
examples.zh: 專案在最後一刻流產，她感到心碎。

examples.en: He respectfully declined the invitation to speak at the event.
examples.zh: 他恭敬地婉拒了在活動中演講的邀請。

examples.en: Please address the judge respectfully in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 在法庭上請尊敬地稱呼法官。

examples.en: The children ran excitedly toward the ice cream truck.
examples.zh: 孩子們興奮地跑向冰淇淋車。

examples.en: She excitedly told us about her acceptance to the university.
examples.zh: 她興奮地告訴我們她被大學錄取了。

examples.en: The mass of a protein is often expressed in daltons.
examples.zh: 蛋白質的質量通常以道爾頓為單位表示。

examples.en: One dalton is approximately the mass of a hydrogen atom.
examples.zh: 一道爾頓大約是一個氫原子的質量。

examples.en: His mania for collecting stamps has filled several albums.
examples.zh: 他對集郵的狂熱已經填滿了好幾本集郵冊。

examples.en: The doctor diagnosed the patient with mania after a thorough evaluation.
examples.zh: 醫生經過詳細評估後診斷病人患有躁狂症。

examples.en: The headlights of the oncoming car dazzled me for a moment.
examples.zh: 迎面而來的車頭燈讓我眼花了一會兒。

examples.en: Her brilliant performance dazzled the audience.
examples.zh: 她出色的表演讓觀眾為之傾倒。

examples.en: The teacher admonished the students for talking during the exam.
examples.zh: 老師訓誡學生們在考試時講話。

examples.en: She admonished him to be more careful with his spending.
examples.zh: 她告誡他花錢要更謹慎。

examples.en: For dessert, we had a creamy custard topped with fresh berries.
examples.zh: 甜點我們吃了上面鋪著新鮮莓果的奶油蛋奶糕。

examples.en: The recipe calls for eggs, milk, and sugar to make the custard.
examples.zh: 這個食譜需要雞蛋、牛奶和糖來製作蛋奶糕。

examples.en: The accident left him senseless for several minutes.
examples.zh: 那場事故讓他失去知覺好幾分鐘。

examples.en: It was a senseless act of violence that shocked the community.
examples.zh: 那是一起毫無意義的暴力行為，震驚了社區。

examples.en: The sender of the package forgot to include a return address.
examples.zh: 包裹的寄件人忘了附上回郵地址。

examples.en: She checked the sender before opening the mysterious envelope.
examples.zh: 她在打開神秘信封前先查看了寄件人。

examples.en: Rapid industrialization brought both economic growth and environmental problems.
examples.zh: 快速的工業化帶來了經濟成長，也帶來了環境問題。

examples.en: The government promoted industrialization to create more jobs.
examples.zh: 政府推動工業化以創造更多就業機會。

examples.en: They gathered firewood to keep the campfire burning all night.
examples.zh: 他們收集木柴讓營火整夜燃燒。

examples.en: A pile of firewood was stacked neatly beside the fireplace.
examples.zh: 壁爐旁整齊地堆著一堆木柴。

examples.en: His sneer suggested that he didn't believe a word I said.
examples.zh: 他的冷笑暗示他一點也不相信我說的話。

examples.en: She sneered at the idea of working for such a small company.
examples.zh: 她對在這麼小的公司工作的想法嗤之以鼻。

examples.en: In the past, expressing such ideas was considered heresy.
examples.zh: 在過去，表達這樣的想法被視為異端。

examples.en: His scientific theory was initially condemned as heresy.
examples.zh: 他的科學理論最初被譴責為異端邪說。

examples.en: A whirlwind swept across the field, lifting dust into the air.
examples.zh: 一陣旋風掃過田野，揚起漫天塵土。

examples.en: The past week has been a whirlwind of meetings and deadlines.
examples.zh: 過去一週是會議和截止期限的旋風。

examples.en: She identifies as bisexual and is attracted to people of both sexes.
examples.zh: 她認同自己是雙性戀，對兩性都有吸引力。

examples.en: The organization provides support for bisexual and other LGBTQ individuals.
examples.zh: 該組織為雙性戀者及其他LGBTQ族群提供支持。

examples.en: The museum houses a priceless collection of ancient artifacts.
examples.zh: 博物館收藏著一批無價的古代文物。

examples.en: Her advice was priceless when I was starting my business.
examples.zh: 當我創業時，她的建議是無價的。

examples.en: The tall spruce trees provided shade for the entire garden.
examples.zh: 高大的雲杉樹為整個花園提供了遮蔭。

examples.en: He spruced up his outfit before the job interview.
examples.zh: 他在工作面試前打扮整齊。

examples.en: The sheep were grazing peacefully in the meadow.
examples.zh: 羊群在草地上平靜地吃草。

examples.en: Grazing on the hillside has been a common practice for centuries.
examples.zh: 在山坡上放牧數百年來一直是常見的做法。

examples.en: The vagina is a muscular canal that connects the cervix to the outside.
examples.zh: 陰道是連接子宮頸與外部的肌肉管道。

examples.en: Regular check-ups help maintain vaginal health.
examples.zh: 定期檢查有助於維持陰道健康。

examples.en: The flickering candlelight made the room feel cozy and mysterious.
examples.zh: 閃爍的燭光讓房間感覺溫馨又神秘。

examples.en: We watched the flickering images on the old television screen.
examples.zh: 我們看著老舊電視螢幕上閃爍的影像。

examples.en: Doctors sometimes prescribe a steroid to reduce severe inflammation.
examples.zh: 醫生有時會開類固醇來減輕嚴重的發炎。

examples.en: The athlete was banned after testing positive for a steroid.
examples.zh: 那名運動員因類固醇檢測呈陽性而被禁賽。

examples.en: The wildfire spread quickly through the dry forest.
examples.zh: 野火迅速蔓延過乾燥的森林。

examples.en: Firefighters worked all night to contain the wildfire.
examples.zh: 消防員整夜工作以控制野火。

examples.en: In the story, the old woman was accused of witchcraft.
examples.zh: 在故事中，老婦人被指控施行巫術。

examples.en: Many centuries ago, people feared witchcraft and magic.
examples.zh: 許多世紀以前，人們畏懼巫術和魔法。

examples.en: She lives in Queens and commutes to Manhattan every day.
examples.zh: 她住在皇后區，每天通勤到曼哈頓。

examples.en: The chess game ended when both queens were captured.
examples.zh: 當兩個皇后都被吃掉時，棋局就結束了。

examples.en: He gave her a handwritten note for her birthday.
examples.zh: 他給她一張手寫的生日便條。

examples.en: The handwritten letter was difficult to read.
examples.zh: 這封手寫的信很難辨讀。

examples.en: The museum displayed a facsimile of the original document.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了原始文件的摹本。

examples.en: Please send the contract by facsimile if you can't email it.
examples.zh: 如果你不能用電子郵件，請用傳真發送合約。

examples.en: She was rushed to the hospital after an overdose of painkillers.
examples.zh: 她因服用過量止痛藥而被緊急送往醫院。

examples.en: Be careful not to overdose on vitamin supplements.
examples.zh: 小心不要服用過量的維生素補充劑。

examples.en: She coveted her neighbor's beautiful garden.
examples.zh: 她垂涎鄰居美麗的花園。

examples.en: Many people covet the latest smartphone models.
examples.zh: 許多人渴望最新款的智慧型手機。

examples.en: His sarcasm hurt her feelings, even though he meant it as a joke.
examples.zh: 他的諷刺傷了她的感情，儘管他本意是開玩笑。

examples.en: I could hear the sarcasm in her voice when she said 'great job'.
examples.zh: 當她說「做得好」時，我聽得出她語氣中的諷刺。

examples.en: The soup was simmering on the stove for hours.
examples.zh: 湯在爐子上燉了好幾個小時。

examples.en: She felt a simmering anger after the argument.
examples.zh: 爭吵後，她感到一股即將爆發的怒氣。

examples.en: The cat disappeared into a dark alleyway.
examples.zh: 那隻貓消失在一條黑暗的小巷裡。

examples.en: They walked through a narrow alleyway to reach the market.
examples.zh: 他們穿過一條狹窄的小巷到達市場。

examples.en: The bomb squad safely detonated the suspicious package.
examples.zh: 拆彈小組安全地引爆了那個可疑包裹。

examples.en: The fireworks detonated high above the crowd.
examples.zh: 煙火在人群上方高空爆炸。

examples.en: The wind ruffled the surface of the lake.
examples.zh: 風吹皺了湖面。

examples.en: Don't let his comments ruffle your feathers.
examples.zh: 別讓他的評論激怒你。

examples.en: She bought a new set of cooking utensils for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她為廚房買了一套新的烹飪用具。

examples.en: Please wash the utensils after you finish eating.
examples.zh: 吃完飯後請清洗餐具。

examples.en: This food contains no artificial additives.
examples.zh: 這種食物不含人工添加物。

examples.en: The additive improved the fuel's performance.
examples.zh: 這種添加劑提升了燃料的性能。

examples.en: His pessimism about the future made everyone feel down.
examples.zh: 他對未來的悲觀讓每個人都感到沮喪。

examples.en: Despite the setbacks, she refused to give in to pessimism.
examples.zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，她拒絕向悲觀主義屈服。

examples.en: I have a dental checkup scheduled for next week.
examples.zh: 我下週預約了牙科檢查。

examples.en: Regular checkups can help detect health problems early.
examples.zh: 定期健康檢查有助於及早發現健康問題。

examples.en: My grandfather loved watching old Chaplin films.
examples.zh: 我祖父喜歡看卓別林的老電影。

examples.en: The actor dressed as Chaplin for the costume party.
examples.zh: 那位演員打扮成卓別林參加化裝舞會。

examples.en: I borrowed a screwdriver to tighten the loose hinge on the door.
examples.zh: 我借了一把螺絲起子來鎖緊門上鬆脫的鉸鏈。

examples.en: She ordered a screwdriver at the bar and sipped it slowly.
examples.zh: 她在酒吧點了一杯螺絲起子雞尾酒，慢慢地啜飲。

examples.en: The contract was declared null after the lawyer found a serious error.
examples.zh: 律師發現嚴重錯誤後，該合約被宣告無效。

examples.en: In programming, a null value often indicates that no data is present.
examples.zh: 在程式設計中，空值通常表示沒有資料存在。

examples.en: The company aims to create an egalitarian workplace where everyone is treated fairly.
examples.zh: 這家公司旨在創造一個人人受到公平對待的平等主義工作環境。

examples.en: As an egalitarian, she believes that all people deserve equal rights and opportunities.
examples.zh: 作為一名平等主義者，她相信所有人都應享有平等的權利與機會。

examples.en: The interviewee answered each question with confidence and clarity.
examples.zh: 被面試者自信而清晰地回答了每個問題。

examples.en: Before the interview, the interviewee reviewed her notes carefully.
examples.zh: 面試前，被面試者仔細複習了她的筆記。

examples.en: He used a metal skewer to hold the pieces of chicken on the grill.
examples.zh: 他用金屬烤肉叉把雞肉塊固定在烤架上。

examples.en: The chef skewered the vegetables and brushed them with olive oil.
examples.zh: 廚師把蔬菜串起來，並刷上橄欖油。

examples.en: She deftly avoided the question by changing the subject.
examples.zh: 她巧妙地轉移話題，避開了那個問題。

examples.en: The surgeon deftly stitched the wound with steady hands.
examples.zh: 外科醫生以穩定的雙手熟練地縫合了傷口。

examples.en: Our new software is designed to outperform all competitors in speed.
examples.zh: 我們的新軟體旨在速度上勝過所有競爭對手。

examples.en: The team outperformed expectations by finishing the project early.
examples.zh: 該團隊提前完成專案，表現超出預期。

examples.en: The heavy book fell to the floor with a loud thud.
examples.zh: 那本厚重的書砰的一聲掉到地板上。

examples.en: I heard a thud upstairs and went to check what had happened.
examples.zh: 我聽到樓上砰的一聲，便上樓查看發生了什麼事。

examples.en: Her piercing scream echoed through the empty hallway.
examples.zh: 她刺耳的尖叫聲在空蕩的走廊裡迴盪。

examples.en: He gave me a piercing look that made me feel uneasy.
examples.zh: 他銳利地看了我一眼，讓我感到不安。

examples.en: A feeling of helplessness washed over her when she lost her keys.
examples.zh: 當她丟了鑰匙時，一股無助感湧上心頭。

examples.en: He stared at the broken machine with helplessness.
examples.zh: 他無助地盯著那台故障的機器。

examples.en: The government imposed tariffs to stop the dumping of cheap steel.
examples.zh: 政府課徵關稅以阻止廉價鋼材的傾銷。

examples.en: Illegal dumping of waste in the river has harmed local wildlife.
examples.zh: 非法傾倒廢棄物到河裡已危害當地野生動物。

examples.en: After the accident, she visited a physiotherapist twice a week.
examples.zh: 事故後，她每週去看兩次物理治療師。

examples.en: The physiotherapist taught him exercises to strengthen his back.
examples.zh: 物理治療師教他做一些運動來強化背部。

examples.en: During the storm, some people began to hoard food and water.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，有些人開始囤積食物和水。

examples.en: He kept a secret hoard of coins under his bed.
examples.zh: 他在床下藏了一堆硬幣。

examples.en: She wore a silver pendant that her grandmother had given her.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條祖母給她的銀墜飾。

examples.en: The pendant light above the dining table cast a warm glow.
examples.zh: 餐桌上方那盞吊燈散發出溫暖的光芒。

examples.en: The restaurant had a classy atmosphere with soft lighting and jazz music.
examples.zh: 那家餐廳有柔和的燈光和爵士樂，氣氛高雅。

examples.en: He looked classy in his tailored suit at the wedding.
examples.zh: 他在婚禮上穿著訂製西裝，看起來很有品味。

examples.en: The birds perform an elaborate dance during the mating season.
examples.zh: 這些鳥在交配季節會表演複雜的舞蹈。

examples.en: Mating calls of frogs can be heard near the pond at night.
examples.zh: 夜晚在池塘邊可以聽到青蛙的交配鳴叫。

examples.en: I prefer wholemeal bread because it has more fiber.
examples.zh: 我比較喜歡全麥麵包，因為它纖維更多。

examples.en: She baked a wholemeal cake using flour ground from whole wheat.
examples.zh: 她用全麥磨成的麵粉烤了一個全麥蛋糕。

examples.en: Sugar is highly soluble in water, especially when heated.
examples.zh: 糖非常溶於水，尤其是加熱時。

examples.en: The problem is soluble if we break it into smaller parts.
examples.zh: 如果我們把問題拆成較小的部分，它就可以解決。

examples.en: She smiled fondly as she looked at old family photos.
examples.zh: 她看著舊家庭照片時，深情地笑了。

examples.en: He fondly remembers the summers he spent at his grandparents' farm.
examples.zh: 他深情地回憶在祖父母農場度過的夏天。

examples.en: Nissan is a Japanese car manufacturer known for its reliable vehicles.
examples.zh: 日產是一家以可靠車輛聞名的日本汽車製造商。

examples.en: He drives a Nissan that he bought five years ago.
examples.zh: 他開的是五年前買的日產汽車。

examples.en: The twisting mountain road made the drive both scary and beautiful.
examples.zh: 那條蜿蜒的山路讓這段車程既可怕又美麗。

examples.en: He was accused of twisting her words to make her look guilty.
examples.zh: 他被指控扭曲她的話，讓她看起來有罪。

examples.en: If the screen freezes, press this button to reset the device.
examples.zh: 如果螢幕當機，按下這個按鈕來重置裝置。

examples.en: After the initial failure, they decided to reset their strategy completely.
examples.zh: 在初次失敗後，他們決定完全重新設定策略。

examples.en: She wore a necklace with a large ruby in the center.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條中間鑲有大紅寶石的項鍊。

examples.en: The sunset painted the sky a deep ruby red.
examples.zh: 日落將天空染成深紅寶石色。

examples.en: The young pianist's skill astounded everyone in the audience.
examples.zh: 那位年輕鋼琴家的技巧讓所有觀眾大為驚駭。

examples.en: It astounds me how quickly technology changes our daily lives.
examples.zh: 科技改變我們日常生活的速度讓我大為吃驚。

examples.en: Good teachers imbue their students with a love of learning.
examples.zh: 好的老師會灌輸學生對學習的熱愛。

examples.en: The old house was imbued with a sense of history.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子充滿了歷史感。

examples.en: We witnessed a wondrous display of colors in the northern sky.
examples.zh: 我們在北方天空目睹了一場令人驚奇的色彩展示。

examples.en: The garden looked wondrous after the fresh snowfall.
examples.zh: 剛下過雪後，花園看起來美妙極了。

examples.en: A snake slithered quietly through the tall grass.
examples.zh: 一條蛇悄悄地滑過長草叢。

examples.en: The children watched the lizard slither up the wall.
examples.zh: 孩子們看著蜥蜴滑上牆壁。

examples.en: The weathered old barn stood at the edge of the field.
examples.zh: 那座風化的舊穀倉矗立在田野邊緣。

examples.en: His weathered face showed years of working outdoors.
examples.zh: 他風霜的臉龐顯示出多年在戶外工作的痕跡。

examples.en: The priest will baptize the baby during Sunday's service.
examples.zh: 神父將在週日禮拜中為嬰兒施洗。

examples.en: They decided to baptize their daughter in the village church.
examples.zh: 他們決定在村莊教堂為女兒施洗。

examples.en: The pain was localized to a small area on his back.
examples.zh: 疼痛局限在他背部的一小塊區域。

examples.en: The storm caused localized flooding in low-lying areas.
examples.zh: 這場風暴在低窪地區造成局部淹水。

examples.en: A thick fog shrouded the entire valley at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明時分，濃霧籠罩了整個山谷。

examples.en: The ceremony was shrouded in secrecy for privacy reasons.
examples.zh: 出於隱私原因，這場儀式被保密籠罩。

examples.en: The poet achieved immortality through his timeless verses.
examples.zh: 這位詩人透過他不朽的詩句獲得了不朽的聲望。

examples.en: Many ancient cultures believed in the immortality of the soul.
examples.zh: 許多古代文化相信靈魂不滅。

examples.en: The sudden noise spooked the horse and it ran off.
examples.zh: 突如其來的噪音驚嚇了馬，牠就跑掉了。

examples.en: Don't spook the birds while they are feeding.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在進食時不要驚嚇牠們。

examples.en: She has a childlike sense of wonder about the world.
examples.zh: 她對世界有一種孩子般的好奇心。

examples.en: His childlike trust in strangers worried his parents.
examples.zh: 他對陌生人天真爛漫的信任讓父母擔心。

examples.en: The baby was born with a congenital heart defect.
examples.zh: 這個嬰兒出生時就有先天性心臟缺陷。

examples.en: Doctors are studying the causes of congenital diseases.
examples.zh: 醫生們正在研究先天性疾病的原因。

examples.en: They serve wholesome meals made with fresh local ingredients.
examples.zh: 他們提供用新鮮本地食材製作的有益健康的餐點。

examples.en: The film offers wholesome entertainment for the whole family.
examples.zh: 這部電影為全家人提供了健全的娛樂。

examples.en: The group was persecuted for their religious beliefs.
examples.zh: 這個團體因宗教信仰而受到迫害。

examples.en: He felt persecuted by constant criticism from his boss.
examples.zh: 他覺得被老闆不斷的批評困擾著。

examples.en: We enjoyed salted fish with rice for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我們早餐吃了鹽醃的魚配飯。

examples.en: The recipe calls for a cup of salted butter.
examples.zh: 這個食譜需要一杯有鹽的奶油。

examples.en: The sudden downpour drenched us completely.
examples.zh: 突如其來的大雨把我們徹底淋濕了。

examples.en: She drenched the plants with water before leaving.
examples.zh: 她離開前把植物澆得濕透。

examples.en: She packed a warm nightgown for the cold nights.
examples.zh: 她帶了一件保暖的睡衣以應付寒冷的夜晚。

examples.en: The little girl wore a pink nightgown to bed.
examples.zh: 小女孩穿著粉紅色的睡衣上床睡覺。

examples.en: She placed the fresh flowers in a tall ceramic urn.
examples.zh: 她將鮮花插入一個高大的陶瓷甕中。

examples.en: The ancient urn was discovered during the excavation.
examples.zh: 這件古老的甕是在挖掘過程中發現的。

examples.en: The study examined the causation between smoking and lung cancer.
examples.zh: 這項研究探討了吸菸與肺癌之間的因果關係。

examples.en: Philosophers have long debated the nature of causation.
examples.zh: 哲學家們長期爭論因果關係的本質。

examples.en: You need to configure the software before using it.
examples.zh: 你需要先設定軟體才能使用。

examples.en: The technician configured the network for optimal performance.
examples.zh: 技術人員配置了網路以達到最佳效能。

examples.en: The gates of the park open at sunrise.
examples.zh: 公園的大門在日出時開放。

examples.en: Please close the gates behind you.
examples.zh: 請隨手關上你身後的大門。

examples.en: A slice of bread contains about 80 calories.
examples.zh: 一片麵包大約含有80卡路里。

examples.en: She counts calories to maintain her weight.
examples.zh: 她計算卡路里以維持體重。

examples.en: The cardiologist recommended a change in diet and exercise.
examples.zh: 心臟科醫師建議改變飲食和運動習慣。

examples.en: After the tests, her cardiologist scheduled a follow-up appointment.
examples.zh: 檢查後，她的心臟科醫師安排了回診。

examples.en: The water was chemically treated before being released.
examples.zh: 水在排放前經過化學處理。

examples.en: These two substances react chemically when mixed.
examples.zh: 這兩種物質混合時會發生化學反應。

examples.en: The rotting fruit attracted flies and bees.
examples.zh: 腐爛的水果吸引了蒼蠅和蜜蜂。

examples.en: A smell of rotting wood filled the old house.
examples.zh: 老房子裡瀰漫著腐爛木材的氣味。

examples.en: He learned to scuba dive during his vacation in Okinawa.
examples.zh: 他在沖繩度假時學會了水肺潛水。

examples.en: Scuba gear allows divers to breathe underwater.
examples.zh: 水肺裝備讓潛水員能在水下呼吸。

examples.en: The technology is still evolving and improving rapidly.
examples.zh: 這項技術仍在快速演進和改進。

examples.en: Scientists study how species are evolving over time.
examples.zh: 科學家研究物種如何隨著時間演化。

examples.en: Some people worry that the issue has become politicized.
examples.zh: 有些人擔心這個議題已經被政治化了。

examples.en: The mayor tried not to politicize the disaster relief efforts.
examples.zh: 市長試圖不讓救災工作政治化。

examples.en: The kitten was a fluffy little kitty with bright eyes.
examples.zh: 那隻小貓是一隻毛茸茸、眼睛明亮的小貓咪。

examples.en: Everyone contributed to the kitty to buy snacks for the party.
examples.zh: 每個人都出錢湊公費，為派對買零食。

examples.en: The mechanic replaced the damaged piston in the engine.
examples.zh: 技師更換了引擎中損壞的活塞。

examples.en: A piston moves up and down inside the cylinder.
examples.zh: 活塞在汽缸內上下移動。

examples.en: The museum displays a restored World War II battleship.
examples.zh: 博物館展示了一艘修復的二戰戰艦。

examples.en: The battleship was too large to enter the harbor.
examples.zh: 那艘戰艦太大，無法進入港口。

examples.en: He is a computer geek who loves building his own servers.
examples.zh: 他是個電腦狂熱者，喜歡自己組裝伺服器。

examples.en: She felt like a geek at the party because she only talked about science.
examples.zh: 她在派對上覺得自己像個怪咖，因為她只談科學。

examples.en: I ordered a waffle with maple syrup for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐點了一份淋上楓糖漿的華夫餅。

examples.en: Stop waffling and give me a straight answer.
examples.zh: 別再胡扯了，給我一個直接的答案。

examples.en: She plays the clarinet in the school band.
examples.zh: 她在學校樂隊吹奏單簧管。

examples.en: The clarinet solo was the highlight of the concert.
examples.zh: 單簧管獨奏是音樂會的亮點。

examples.en: The police arrested the men for smuggling drugs across the border.
examples.zh: 警方逮捕了那些男子，因為他們走私毒品跨越邊境。

examples.en: Smuggling goods into the country is a serious crime.
examples.zh: 將貨物走私入境是嚴重的罪行。

examples.en: The clock began to chime at exactly noon.
examples.zh: 時鐘在正午時分開始鳴響。

examples.en: Wind chimes hanging by the window chimed softly in the breeze.
examples.zh: 掛在窗邊的風鈴在微風中輕柔地作響。

examples.en: The band practiced marching in perfect formation for the parade.
examples.zh: 樂隊為了遊行練習以完美的隊形行進。

examples.en: Marching for hours under the hot sun left the soldiers exhausted.
examples.zh: 在烈日下行軍數小時讓士兵們筋疲力盡。

examples.en: Thick smog covered the city and made it hard to breathe.
examples.zh: 濃厚的煙霧籠罩城市，讓人難以呼吸。

examples.en: Officials advised people to stay indoors because of the smog.
examples.zh: 由於煙霧瀰漫，官員建議民眾待在室內。

examples.en: The teacher quickly quelled the argument between the two students.
examples.zh: 老師迅速平息了兩名學生之間的爭吵。

examples.en: She took a deep breath to quell her nervousness before the speech.
examples.zh: 她在演講前深吸一口氣以減輕緊張。

examples.en: The unfair decision enraged the entire team.
examples.zh: 不公平的決定激怒了整個團隊。

examples.en: It enrages me to see people littering in the park.
examples.zh: 看到有人在公園亂丟垃圾讓我非常生氣。

examples.en: We found affordable lodging near the train station.
examples.zh: 我們在火車站附近找到價格合理的住宿。

examples.en: The travelers needed lodging for the night after their long journey.
examples.zh: 旅客們長途旅行後需要過夜的住所。

examples.en: Regular pruning keeps the rose bushes healthy and blooming.
examples.zh: 定期修剪能讓玫瑰叢保持健康並開花。

examples.en: He gathered the pruning from the trees and put it in a pile.
examples.zh: 他收集了從樹上剪下的枝葉，堆成一堆。

examples.en: My neighbor is Bulgarian and often cooks traditional dishes.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居是保加利亞人，經常烹煮傳統菜餚。

examples.en: She has been learning Bulgarian for two years.
examples.zh: 她學習保加利亞語已經兩年了。

examples.en: He has practiced karate since he was a child.
examples.zh: 他從小就練習空手道。

examples.en: The karate class focuses on discipline and self-defense.
examples.zh: 空手道課程著重於紀律與自衛。

examples.en: Her nagging complaints about the noise made everyone uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 她對噪音的嘮叨抱怨讓大家都不舒服。

examples.en: He has a nagging habit of checking his phone every minute.
examples.zh: 他有每分鐘檢查手機的煩人習慣。

examples.en: The doctor treated his fractured arm with a cast.
examples.zh: 醫生用石膏治療他骨折的手臂。

examples.en: The vase fell and left a fractured piece on the floor.
examples.zh: 花瓶掉落，在地板上留下裂片。

examples.en: Please sync your calendar so everyone can see your schedule.
examples.zh: 請同步你的行事曆，讓大家都能看到你的行程。

examples.en: The app automatically syncs photos across all your devices.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式會自動在所有裝置間同步照片。

examples.en: The cruel ruler oppressed the people for many years.
examples.zh: 殘暴的統治者壓迫人民多年。

examples.en: The heavy humidity oppressed everyone during the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天沉重的濕氣讓每個人都感到鬱悶。

examples.en: The teacher marked the absentee on the attendance sheet.
examples.zh: 老師在點名表上標記了缺席者。

examples.en: Absentee workers must provide a doctor's note.
examples.zh: 缺勤的員工必須提供醫生證明。

examples.en: I hereby declare the meeting officially open.
examples.zh: 我在此宣布會議正式開始。

examples.en: You are hereby notified that your application has been approved.
examples.zh: 特此通知您，您的申請已獲批准。

examples.en: She wore a violet dress to the evening party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件紫羅蘭色的洋裝去參加晚會。

examples.en: Violets bloomed along the forest path in early spring.
examples.zh: 初春時，紫羅蘭沿著森林小徑盛開。

examples.en: The coach gave the team a pep talk before the final game.
examples.zh: 教練在決賽前給球隊一番激勵談話。

examples.en: A good breakfast will pep you up for the long day ahead.
examples.zh: 一頓豐盛的早餐能讓你打起精神面對漫長的一天。

examples.en: The movie is about a zombie who wanders through the abandoned town.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一個殭屍在廢棄小鎮中遊蕩。

examples.en: After staying up all night, I felt like a zombie at work.
examples.zh: 熬夜整晚後，我上班時感覺像個行屍走肉。
